proposal.explanation: Three reheatable six-serving meals featuring raw andouille. Cook the sausage thoroughly in each recipe; its raw form is not interchangeable with fully cooked andouille.

dishes.title: Andouille, White Bean, and Kale Stew

ingredients.displayName: Canned Great Northern beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Brown the raw sausage, breaking it into bite-size pieces; cook until a thermometer inserted in the thickest pieces reads 160°F (71°C).
Transfer sausage to the slow cooker. Add onion, carrots, celery, garlic, beans, broth, tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf, and pepper.
Cover and cook on High for about 4 hours, until vegetables are tender and the stew is bubbling. Remove the bay leaf.
Stir in kale, cover, and cook another 15–20 minutes until wilted. Check that the stew is piping hot throughout before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat portions in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot throughout; add a splash of broth if thick.

dishes.title: Andouille, Potato, and Pepper Bake
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch baking dish in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and brown the raw sausage, breaking it into chunks. Cook until the thickest pieces reach 160°F (71°C), then transfer to the baking dish.
Add potatoes, peppers, onion, broccoli, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, pepper, and salt. Toss to coat, then pour broth around the vegetables.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35 minutes. Remove foil, stir, and bake 10–15 minutes more, until potatoes are tender and the casserole is bubbling.
Sprinkle cheddar over the top and bake uncovered for 5 minutes, until melted. Rest for 5 minutes before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot throughout, or microwave covered, stirring once. Add a spoonful of broth before reheating if the potatoes seem dry.

dishes.title: Andouille, Black Bean, and Tomato Chili
dishes.appliance: 6-quart heavy-bottomed Dutch oven on the stovetop

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Brown the raw sausage in bite-size pieces, stirring, until the thickest pieces reach 160°F (71°C). Transfer to a plate.
Add onion and bell pepper to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika; stir for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, beans, broth, salt, and pepper. Return sausage and any juices to the pot.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and bubbling. Taste and adjust salt if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Chili thickens as it chills. Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring occasionally and adding a little broth or water as needed, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey, Tomato & Cheddar Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, for 6–8 minutes; drain excess liquid if needed.
Add turkey to the slow cooker with tomatoes, onions, carrots, broth, garlic powder, ginger, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 hours, until the carrots are tender and the turkey is fully cooked. Stir in cheddar until melted before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through; add a splash of broth if it has thickened.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato & Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown turkey with the onions for 7–9 minutes, breaking the meat into small pieces.
Stir in garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, and tomato paste; cook for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes, beans, water, and salt.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and the turkey is fully cooked. Serve with cheddar if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if needed; microwave individual portions covered, stirring halfway.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Rice Casserole
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch oven-safe baking dish and conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown turkey with onions for 7–9 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper into the turkey. Transfer to the baking dish and mix with dry rice, tomatoes, and broth.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 55 minutes. Check that the rice is tender and the turkey fully cooked; if needed, add a splash of hot broth, re-cover, and bake 5–10 minutes more.
Uncover, scatter cheddar over the casserole, and bake 5 minutes until melted. Rest 10 minutes before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in the microwave with a spoonful of water or broth, stirring once; alternatively, cover the dish with foil and warm at 325°F until hot.

dishes.title: Garlic Olive Oil Chicken and Rice Skillet
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Brown beef stew meat in olive oil inside a heavy Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add minced garlic, diced potatoes, and sliced carrots.
Pour in beef broth and season with salt.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 90 minutes until the beef is tender and potatoes are fork-soft.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered pot over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally until heated through.

dishes.title: Garlic Roasted Vegetable and Bean Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
In a large bowl, toss rinsed cannellini beans, chopped broccoli florets, minced garlic, crushed tomatoes, olive oil, and salt together.
Transfer the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Top with cheddar cheese and bake for an additional 10 minutes until melted and bubbly.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes until warmed through.

dishes.title: Turkey Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the turkey and brown it, breaking it apart, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer.

dishes.title: Coconut Chicken Thigh Curry

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes and remove.
Lower heat to medium and cook the onion until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Return chicken to the skillet with potatoes, coconut milk, and salt.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes, until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165 F.
Uncover and simmer 5 minutes to thicken the sauce.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours. Reheat covered in a skillet over medium-low heat with a spoonful of water, stirring until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Beef and Vegetable Stew

ingredients.displayName: Raw beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 8 minutes total. Remove.
Cook onion in the same pot for 5 minutes, then add garlic and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot with broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise over low heat for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover, and simmer 40 minutes more until tender and beef is fork-tender.
Remove bay leaves and adjust salt before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours. Reheat covered over medium-low heat, adding a splash of broth if thick, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.appliance: Large covered Dutch oven or deep stovetop skillet

steps: Put beef, barley, carrots, celery, onion, ginger, and garlic in the slow cooker.
Whisk broth with tomato paste and soy sauce; pour over the ingredients and add thyme and pepper.

dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in portions. Reheat covered in a saucepan over medium-low heat or in the microwave until steaming, stirring well; add broth or water as barley thickens the stew.

proposal.explanation: Remixed the seed into three six-serving meals suited to a slow cooker; none requires an oven. Pantry availability is not treated as proof of sufficient quantity, and no price claims are made.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey, Tomato & Ginger Pot
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Crumble in the turkey and cook, stirring, until browned; drain excess liquid if needed.
Put browned turkey, tomatoes, onion, garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until the onion is tender and the mixture is bubbling throughout.
Stir well and portion. Add cheddar when serving if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in the microwave, stirring halfway, until steaming hot; add a splash of water if thick. Alternatively warm gently in a saucepan.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey & Black Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Brown the turkey, breaking it up as it cooks; transfer to the slow cooker.
Add beans, tomatoes, onion, bell pepper, garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours. Stir before serving and check that the chili is piping hot throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a microwave-safe dish, stirring halfway, until steaming hot. Loosen with a little water if needed; portions also reheat well in a saucepan over medium-low heat.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken, Chickpea & Tomato Curry

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken in batches for a few minutes; it need not be cooked through.
Transfer chicken to the slow cooker. Stir in chickpeas, tomatoes, onion, garlic, coconut milk, curry powder, ginger, and salt.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until chicken is thoroughly cooked and tender. Stir before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered portions in the microwave, stirring halfway, until steaming hot throughout. Add a splash of water or coconut milk if the sauce has thickened; alternatively reheat gently on the stovetop.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onions and minced garlic, sautéing until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, draining excess fat.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and rinsed kidney beans.
Simmer on low heat for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat with a splash of water until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Boil or steam the chopped broccoli and diced chicken breasts until just cooked, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan, add flour and minced garlic to form a paste, then whisk in milk until thickened.
Stir in half of the cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Combine chicken, broccoli, and cheese sauce in the baking dish, and top with remaining cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes until heated through.

dishes.title: Savory Pork and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Cut the pork shoulder into bite-sized chunks.
Chop the sweet potatoes, carrots, and onions into uniform pieces.
Place all vegetables and pork into the slow cooker.
Pour chicken broth over the mixture, then add olive oil, rosemary, and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours until the pork is tender and vegetables are soft.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm gently in a covered pot on the stovetop over medium heat, adding a splash of broth if needed.

proposal.explanation: Three reheatable batch meals for six, all made without tree nuts or dairy. Pantry availability does not establish quantities, so amounts are listed for the full batch.

dishes.title: Tomato-Braised Chicken, Potatoes & Carrots
dishes.appliance: Large Dutch oven or heavy pot with lid
steps: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with some of the salt and pepper, then brown it in batches for about 3 minutes per side; transfer to a plate.
Add the onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring. Add the garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, broth, remaining salt and pepper, and potatoes. Nestle in the chicken and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook over low heat for 50–60 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked through. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions. Reheat covered on the stove over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot; add a splash of water or broth if the stew has thickened.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3–4 days. Reheat covered on the stove until steaming hot throughout, adding a little water or broth if needed.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chili
dishes.appliance: Large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin and smoked paprika; stir for 30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains, about 6–8 minutes.
Stir in sweet potatoes, tomatoes, broth, beans and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer.
Cover partially and simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chili is thick. Add a little water if it becomes thicker than desired.
Cool promptly and portion for storage. Reheat gently in a covered pot, stirring often, until steaming hot; loosen with water or broth as needed.
dishes.reheatTip: This chili thickens in the refrigerator. Reheat covered over medium-low heat, stirring and adding water or broth until it reaches a spoonable consistency and is steaming hot.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea & Spinach Curry with Rice
dishes.appliance: Large deep skillet with lid and a medium saucepan
steps: Rinse the rice. Combine it with 3 cups water and a pinch of the salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and remaining salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the spinach in handfuls and cook uncovered until wilted, about 2 minutes. Taste and adjust salt if needed.
Serve the curry over rice. For batch storage, cool rice and curry promptly and store separately. Reheat each covered with a small splash of water until steaming hot.
dishes.reheatTip: Store rice and curry separately in shallow portions. Reheat covered in the microwave or on the stove with a splash of water, stirring partway through, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Tomato Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew
dishes.appliance: Large Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Warm the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onions and carrots for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds.

Add sweet potatoes, lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer gently for 30–35 minutes, stirring now and then, until lentils and sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cool promptly and portion for storage.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot; add a splash of broth or water if thick. Microwave covered, stirring halfway through.

dishes.title: Chicken, Black Bean, and Rice Casserole
dishes.appliance: Oven, 9-by-13-inch baking dish, and stovetop skillet

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in batches for 4–5 minutes; it need not be cooked through. Transfer to the baking dish.
In the same skillet, cook onion and bell peppers for 5 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin; stir for 30 seconds.
Stir in beans, rice, tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Pour the mixture over the chicken in the dish and mix evenly. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 40 minutes. Check that rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C); if needed, re-cover and bake 5–10 minutes more. Rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff and portion.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered portions in a 350°F (175°C) oven until steaming hot, or microwave covered, stirring midway. Add a spoonful of broth or water before reheating if the rice seems dry.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Cauliflower Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to package directions; keep covered until serving.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large covered Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds. Add cauliflower, chickpeas, coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, broth, and salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender. Stir in lime juice and taste for seasoning.
Serve the curry over rice. Cool promptly and store the rice and curry in meal portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat curry and rice covered in the microwave, stirring midway, or warm gently in a covered saucepan with a splash of water or broth. Heat until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Salmon and Potato Leek Stew
steps: Slice leeks and dice potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat, then cook leeks and minced garlic for 5 minutes until soft.
Add vegetable broth and potatoes, bring to a simmer, and cook 15 minutes until potatoes are nearly tender.
Season salmon with salt and pepper, cut into 2-inch chunks, and nestle into the stew with dried dill.
Cover and simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Finish with lemon juice and zest if using, then adjust salt and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours in airtight containers for up to 3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop over low heat with a splash of broth, stirring carefully to keep salmon intact.

dishes.title: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
steps: Dice onion and bell peppers and mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and soften onion, peppers, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Transfer vegetables to the slow cooker with beans, crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, stirring once halfway through.
Taste, adjust salt, and serve hot.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 4 days. Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat with a little water or broth until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Spinach Mozzarella Baked Pasta
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F and lightly oil a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook pasta in salted water until just al dente, then drain.
Warm olive oil in a skillet, cook minced garlic 1 minute, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Combine pasta, spinach mixture, crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and salt in the baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and Parmesan, cover with foil, and bake 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes more until bubbling and lightly browned on top.
dishes.reheatTip: Portion into airtight containers after cooling, refrigerate up to 4 days, and reheat individual portions covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, or in a 350 F oven until hot.

dishes.title: Turkey and White Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onions and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add turkey and brown, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and salt for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a simmer.
Cover partially and simmer 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low, adding a splash of broth if thickened.

dishes.title: Turkey and Spinach Stuffed Peppers
dishes.appliance: Oven at 375 F in a 9x13 baking dish
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and turkey and brown about 6 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and salt. Simmer 3 minutes.
Arrange pepper halves in baking dish and fill with turkey mixture.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover, top with mozzarella, and bake 10 minutes more.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat covered at 350 F for 15 to 20 minutes, or microwave individual portions until hot.

dishes.title: Turkey Curry Skillet with Rice

steps: Cook basmati rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onions and cook 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Add turkey and brown, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add carrots, coconut milk, and salt. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until carrots are tender.
Serve over rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate curry and rice separately up to 4 days. Reheat curry covered over medium-low with a splash of water, and reheat rice with a damp paper towel in the microwave.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew
steps: Pat beef dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, then set aside.
Saute onions, carrots, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes, then add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, thyme, and bay leaf, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 30 minutes, then add potatoes and simmer 30 minutes more until tender.
Remove bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and cool before portioning into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat, adding a splash of broth if thickened.

dishes.title: Turkey Black Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in stockpot over medium heat and cook turkey until no longer pink.
Add onions and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth, and salt, then simmer uncovered 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool completely and portion into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring and adding water if too thick.

dishes.title: Baked Chicken Thigh and Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 400 F and lightly oil a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Toss potato slices with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper and spread across the dish.
Layer onions, chicken thighs, and garlic over potatoes, then pour broth over the top and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes, then uncover and bake 20 minutes more until chicken reaches 165 F and potatoes are tender.
Top with mozzarella if using and broil 1 to 2 minutes until melted, then cool and portion.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered at 350 F for 20 to 25 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onion and peppers; drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes, then add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in chili powder and garlic powder, then add tomatoes, beans, water and salt. Simmer for 25 minutes, until the turkey is cooked through and the chili thickens.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming hot, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
steps: Dice the onion and sweet potatoes into small cubes. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder and garlic powder.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently until steaming hot, stirring in a little water if thick.

dishes.title: Tomato, White Bean and Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Cook pasta in boiling water for 2 minutes less than package directions; drain.
Dice zucchini, drain and rinse beans, and shred the mozzarella.
Mix pasta, zucchini, beans, tomatoes, water, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and salt in a baking dish. Top with mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes; uncover and bake for 10–15 minutes more, until bubbly and the zucchini is tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered until steaming hot; add a splash of water if dry.

proposal.explanation: Three six-serving batches, each with one specific appliance and method.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken and White Bean Stew
steps: Dice the carrots and onion and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Add chicken, carrots, onion, garlic, broth, thyme and salt to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the carrots are tender.
Shred the chicken, stir in the beans and cook on HIGH for 10 minutes more. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming hot and the chicken reaches 165°F, adding broth or water if needed.

dishes.title: Instant Pot Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Dice the sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces, chop the onion and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Use Sauté to soften the onion in oil for 3 minutes; add garlic and spices for 30 seconds. Add broth and scrape the bottom clean.

Add sweet potatoes, beans and salt. Pour tomatoes on top without stirring. Seal and pressure cook on HIGH for 4 minutes, then let pressure release naturally for 10 minutes before releasing the remainder.
Stir and divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming hot, adding a splash of water if the chili thickens.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Coconut Chickpea Curry
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Cut the cauliflower into florets, chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Combine chickpeas, cauliflower, onion, garlic, coconut milk, curry powder and salt in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours, until the cauliflower is tender.
Stir in spinach, cover and cook for 10 minutes more, until wilted. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently until steaming hot, stirring and adding water if needed.

Discard bay leaves before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm gently in a covered pot over medium-low heat until heated through, stirring occasionally.

dishes.title: Slow Beef Stew with Potatoes and Carrots
steps: Pat the beef dry, toss with flour, salt, and pepper.
Brown beef in olive oil in batches over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes total, then set aside.
Cook chopped onion 4 minutes in the same pot, stir in tomato paste and garlic powder for 1 minute.
Add broth, scraping up browned bits, then return beef with thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer on low 2 hours, or cook on low in a slow cooker for 6 to 7 hours.
Add cubed potatoes and carrots, then simmer uncovered or on high 30 to 45 minutes until tender. Remove bay leaves and adjust salt before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours; reheat portions covered on the stovetop or in the microwave until steaming hot throughout, adding a splash of broth if thickened.

dishes.title: Black Bean and Turkey Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Cook ground turkey 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Add diced onion and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and oregano for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, beans, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Cover partly and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours; reheat covered over medium heat with a splash of water, stirring until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Chicken Thigh Coconut Curry
steps: Cook basmati rice separately according to package directions for about 3 cups dry yield.
Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and cook diced onion 5 minutes.
Stir in curry powder, garam masala, ground ginger, and garlic powder for 1 minute.
Add chicken cut into bite-size pieces and cook 5 minutes until browned.
Add diced tomatoes, coconut milk, and salt. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in spinach and simmer uncovered 3 minutes until wilted. Portion with rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate curry and rice separately within 2 hours; reheat curry covered over medium heat with a splash of water, and reheat rice with a teaspoon of water in the microwave until hot.

proposal.explanation: Generated three distinct reheatable batch recipes using the requested ground coriander while adhering to the specified target servings and catalog items.

dishes.title: Spiced Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef stew meat on all sides.
Add chopped onions, sliced carrots, and cubed potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in the ground coriander and salt, mixing well with the meat and vegetables.
Pour in the beef broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 75 minutes until the beef is tender.
Remove from heat, let cool, and store for future reheating.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, adding a splash of beef broth if the sauce has thickened too much.

dishes.title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Curry Skillet
steps: Rinse the dried lentils thoroughly under cold water.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until translucent.
Stir in the dried lentils, ground coriander, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in the canned coconut milk and fresh spinach, cooking for another 5 minutes until spinach is wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered skillet over medium-low heat until warmed through, adding a splash of water or broth to restore consistency.

dishes.title: Spiced Chicken and Rice Casserole
steps: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
In a baking dish, combine dry basmati rice, chopped onions, melted butter, salt, and ground coriander.
Pour the chicken broth over the rice mixture and stir gently.
Place the boneless skinless chicken breasts on top of the rice mixture, pressing them down slightly.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake in the oven for 50 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes, or microwave individual portions with a splash of chicken broth until hot.

dishes.title: Gingered Turkey Tomato Pot
steps: Dice the onions and carrots; mince the garlic.
Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it into small pieces, about 6–8 minutes.
Add onions and carrots and cook until starting to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partially, and cook 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheddar until melted. Cool promptly and divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and adding a splash of broth or water if thick; heat until steaming.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in the pot over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, about 6–8 minutes.
Add onions and cook 4 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheddar until melted. Cool promptly and portion into four containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring now and then; loosen with a little water or broth as needed and heat until steaming.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Cheddar Pasta Bake
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Cook pasta in salted boiling water until just shy of tender; drain.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown turkey, breaking it up, about 6–8 minutes. Add onions and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, oregano, tomatoes, broth, and salt. Simmer 10 minutes.
Combine the sauce with drained pasta and half the cheddar. Transfer to the baking dish and scatter mozzarella and remaining cheddar over the top.
Bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes until bubbling and the cheese is melted. Rest 10 minutes before dividing into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat an individual portion covered in the microwave, stirring once if possible, until steaming hot; add a spoonful of water before heating if the pasta seems dry.

proposal.explanation: Remixed the turkey-and-tomato batch pot around fresh ginger and carried that change through three distinct, six-serving batch meals.

dishes.title: Fresh Ginger Turkey Tomato Pot
steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Grate the fresh ginger.
Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add turkey, salt, and pepper; break it up and cook until no longer pink, about 7–9 minutes.
Stir in onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and fresh ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partially, and cook 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and the turkey is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with grated cheddar, if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally; add a splash of water if thick. Or microwave covered, stirring halfway, until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Ginger Turkey, Tomato and Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it into small pieces, about 7–9 minutes; drain excess liquid if needed.
Add diced onions and cook 4–5 minutes until beginning to soften. Stir in garlic and fresh ginger for 1 minute, then stir in chili powder and cumin.
Transfer the mixture to the slow cooker. Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours. Stir before serving and check that the turkey is fully cooked.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat on the stove over medium-low heat, stirring until steaming hot; loosen with a little water if needed. Microwave individual portions covered, stirring once.

dishes.title: Ginger Tomato Turkey and Rice Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Rinse the rice and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, about 7–9 minutes. Add onions and cook 4–5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and fresh ginger and cook for 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine the turkey mixture, rice, crushed tomatoes, and broth in the baking dish. Stir well and cover tightly with foil or a lid.
Bake 50–55 minutes, until the rice is tender and the turkey is fully cooked. Let stand covered for 10 minutes. Fluff gently and top with cheddar if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered portions in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot, or microwave covered with a spoonful of water, stirring halfway through to keep the rice moist.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct batch dishes for 6 servings. Custom entry Moon dust 731 is kept as an unmapped optional seasoning with null ingredientId and no price or identity assumed. Pantry olive oil and garlic are used as available, and other items are proposed shopping ingredients.

dishes.title: Classic Beef and Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground beef, breaking it up, about 6 minutes, then drain excess fat.
Add onions and cook 4 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and Moon dust 731 if using, cooking 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover partly, and simmer 35 minutes, stirring occasionally. Portion into 6 containers once cooled.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered on the stove over medium heat with a splash of water, stirring until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Potato Stew
steps: Place potatoes, carrots, celery, and onion in the slow cooker.
Add chicken thighs, garlic, thyme, bay leaves, pepper, and salt.
Pour chicken broth over the top.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours until chicken shreds easily and vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaves, shred chicken with two forks, stir, and portion into 6 containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat with a little broth until steaming hot, stirring occasionally.

dishes.title: Turkey Marinara Pasta Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F. Cook pasta in salted water until just short of al dente, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, brown the turkey with onion for 7 minutes, then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, and salt. Simmer 5 minutes.
Combine sauce with pasta and spread in a greased 9x13-inch dish.
Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes more until bubbling. Cool and portion into 6 containers.

proposal.explanation: Three reheatable six-serving meals use ground coriander as seasoning; none treats fresh cilantro as an equivalent.

dishes.title: Coriander Beef, Potato, and Carrot Stew
steps: Add beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic, broth, tomato paste, coriander, thyme, salt, and pepper to the slow cooker; stir.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through, about 7 hours.
For a thicker stew, stir cornstarch with cold water until smooth, mix into the stew, and cook covered on high for 15 minutes.
Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions. Reheat gently on the stovetop or in the microwave until steaming hot; add a splash of broth if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered, stirring once; loosen with a little broth if the stew has thickened.

dishes.title: Coriander Red Lentil and Tomato Soup
steps: Warm olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion and carrots, stirring, until beginning to soften, about 6 minutes.
Stir in garlic, coriander, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer.
Cover partially and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft, about 25 to 30 minutes. Stir in optional lemon juice.
Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring and adding broth or water if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Lentils thicken as they sit; stir in a splash of water or broth while reheating until the soup is steaming hot.

dishes.title: Coriander Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered Dutch oven on stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, coriander, and curry powder; stir for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, tomatoes, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently until the sweet potatoes are tender, about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in optional spinach until wilted.
Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions. Reheat covered on the stovetop over low heat, stirring occasionally; add a little broth if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm gently and stir so the coconut sauce heats evenly; avoid a hard boil and add broth to restore a loose curry consistency.

dishes.title: Salmon Coconut Curry Skillet

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions and keep warm.
Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium heat, then cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Season the salmon with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover, and cook 8 to 10 minutes until opaque and flaky at 145 F.
Fold in spinach until wilted, then stir in lemon juice and adjust salt.
Divide rice and curry into containers for storage.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over low heat with 2 tablespoons water for 5 to 7 minutes, or microwave covered at 70 percent power in 1-minute bursts until hot.

dishes.title: Salmon Potato Chowder

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Melt butter in the Dutch oven over medium heat, then cook onion, celery, and carrot 6 minutes.
Stir in flour and thyme and cook 1 minute.
Add broth and potatoes, bring to a simmer, and cook 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in milk and bring back to a gentle simmer without boiling.
Add salmon cubes, cover, and poach 5 to 7 minutes until opaque and flaky at 145 F.
Stir in parsley, salt, and pepper, then portion for storage.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop over low heat, stirring often, for 8 to 10 minutes without boiling; add a splash of milk if thickened.

dishes.title: Salmon Asparagus Rice Bake

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 1-inch pieces
Asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F and lightly grease the baking dish.
Cook brown rice according to package directions and let it cool slightly.
Saute onion in olive oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Whisk eggs, milk, mustard, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Combine rice, onion, asparagus, salmon, and 1 cup cheddar in the dish, then pour the egg mixture over the top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until set and salmon reaches 145 F, sprinkling remaining cheese over the top for the last 5 minutes.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover portions and reheat in a microwave at 70 percent power for 2 to 3 minutes, or in a 350 F oven for 15 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onion and peppers; mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes, then add garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in tomatoes, beans and salt. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 4 days. Reheat until steaming hot and 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the water in a covered saucepan according to package directions.
Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat oil in a deep skillet. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted. Serve in six portions with the rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate rice and curry promptly in shallow containers for up to 4 days. Reheat to 165°F, adding a little water to loosen the curry.

dishes.title: Chicken, Potato and Carrot Braise
steps: Cut chicken into large pieces, potatoes into 1-inch chunks, and carrots into thick slices. Dice onion and mince garlic.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven and cook onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken, potatoes, carrots, broth, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 30–35 minutes, until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Divide into six portions with the broth.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 4 days. Reheat covered until the chicken and broth reach 165°F.

dishes.title: Dutch Oven Beef and Barley Stew
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, then set aside.
Add onions, carrots, and celery; cook 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot. Add broth, bay leaves, thyme, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook gently for 75 minutes.
Stir in barley and simmer covered for 30–35 minutes, until the barley and beef are tender. Remove bay leaves; add a little water or broth if needed.
Cool promptly and refrigerate portions. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and adding broth or water to loosen.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat with a splash of broth or water; stir until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey, Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains, about 6–8 minutes; drain excess liquid if needed.
Add turkey and all remaining ingredients to the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours, until sweet potatoes are tender. Taste and adjust salt.
Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions. Reheat on the stovetop or in a microwave until steaming hot, stirring partway through.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through, or warm gently on the stovetop with a splash of broth.

dishes.title: Oven-Baked Chickpea, Spinach, and Rice Casserole
dishes.appliance: Covered 9-by-13-inch baking dish in a 375°F oven
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. In a skillet, cook onion in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add garlic, curry powder, and cumin; stir for 30 seconds.
Stir in chickpeas and spinach until the spinach starts to wilt. Transfer mixture to the baking dish and mix in dry rice, broth, coconut milk, and salt.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 50 minutes. Check that the rice is tender and liquid absorbed; if needed, re-cover and bake 5–10 minutes more.
Let stand covered for 10 minutes, then fluff gently. Cool promptly and refrigerate in portions.
Reheat covered in a microwave or oven until steaming hot. Add a spoonful of broth or water if the rice has firmed up.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered with a splash of broth or water; stir halfway through microwave reheating to warm evenly.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Smoked Sausage, Potatoes and Peppers
dishes.appliance: Rimmed 18x13 inch sheet pan in a 425°F oven
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed sheet pan with foil or parchment.
Toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt and pepper, then spread on the pan and roast 10 minutes.
Slice the sausage and add it to the pan with the peppers, zucchini and garlic tossed in the remaining oil.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes more, stirring once, until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is browned at the edges.
Divide into four portions and cool within two hours before refrigerating.
dishes.reheatTip: Microwave a portion covered for 2 to 3 minutes, or reheat on a sheet pan at 375°F for 10 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potatoes and Broccoli
dishes.appliance: Rimmed 18x13 inch sheet pan in a 425°F oven
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the sweet potato cubes with 1 tablespoon oil, half the salt and paprika, and roast 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with the remaining oil, garlic, salt and pepper, then add it to the pan with the broccoli.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes more until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and the broccoli is tender.
Portion into four containers once cooled to room temperature within two hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until the chicken is steaming hot throughout, or warm on a sheet pan at 375°F for 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Chickpea and Cauliflower Curry
dishes.appliance: Rimmed 18x13 inch sheet pan in a 425°F oven
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the chickpeas, cauliflower, onion and garlic with the oil, curry powder and salt, then spread on the pan.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until the cauliflower is tender and edged with brown.
Transfer the roasted mixture to a pot, stir in the coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Cool and portion into four containers within two hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway, or simmer gently in a covered pot with a splash of water until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Herb Stew
steps: In a large pot, brown the ground turkey over medium-high heat until fully cooked.
Add diced onions and cook until softened.
Stir in canned crushed tomatoes, garlic powder, and ground ginger.
Simmer the stew on low heat for 25 minutes to meld flavors.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese just before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of water, stirring frequently.

dishes.title: Turkey and Tomato Chili Soup
steps: Brown the ground turkey and chopped onions in a soup pot.
Add chili powder and garlic powder, stirring for 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and chicken broth, bringing to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with shredded cheddar cheese if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Simmer covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat until heated through.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Casserole Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Cook dry pasta according to package directions and drain.
Brown ground turkey and diced onions in a skillet, then stir in crushed tomatoes and garlic powder.
Combine cooked pasta and turkey tomato mixture, transferring to a greased baking dish.
Top with cheddar cheese and bake for 25 minutes until bubbly and golden.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees F for 20 minutes until hot.

dishes.title: Cheesy Turkey Tomato Pot
steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Break the turkey into small pieces in the slow cooker and mix with tomatoes, onion, garlic, ginger, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on high for about 4 hours, stirring and breaking up the turkey halfway through, until the onions are tender and the turkey reaches 165°F.
Divide into six portions and top with shredded cheddar.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming and 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Slow-Cooker Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onions, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the beans.
Break the turkey into small pieces in the slow cooker. Mix in the tomatoes, beans, onion, garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Cover and cook on high for about 4 hours, stirring and breaking up the turkey halfway through, until the onion is tender and the turkey reaches 165°F. Serve in six portions with shredded cheddar.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat to 165°F, stirring and adding water if the chili is too thick.

dishes.title: Ginger Turkey and Chickpea Tomato Curry
steps: Dice the onions, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Break the turkey into small pieces in the slow cooker. Mix in all remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook on high for about 4 hours, stirring and breaking up the turkey halfway through, until the onion is tender and the turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently, stirring, until the curry reaches 165°F.

dishes.appliance: Dutch oven on stovetop or oven at 325°F
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper and brown in olive oil in batches in the Dutch oven, then set aside.
Saute onions, garlic, carrots and celery in the same pot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute, then return beef with broth, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and braise at 325°F for about 2 hours until beef is tender, adding potatoes during the last 30 minutes.
Remove bay leaves, adjust seasoning, cool and refrigerate in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat with a splash of broth until steaming hot throughout.

steps: Heat olive oil in the pot and brown turkey with onions until no pink remains.

Stir in tomatoes, beans and broth, then simmer uncovered 35 to 40 minutes.
Season with salt, cool and portion into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, adding a little water if thickened.

dishes.appliance: Large skillet with lid on stovetop
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt.
Heat olive oil in the skillet and cook chicken until browned, then remove.
Saute onions, garlic and ginger, then stir in curry powder for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk and cauliflower, return chicken, cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over cooked basmati rice if using, cool and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water until hot throughout.

proposal.explanation: Fresh garlic is unavailable, so every dish uses garlic-powder from the current pantry instead of the seed's fresh garlic. The three dishes vary the seed turkey-tomato base across a stew, a chili, and a baked casserole.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato batch pot
steps: Brown the turkey in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add the diced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic powder and ground ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the crushed tomatoes, reduce heat to low, and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in the shredded cheddar until melted, and portion into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in a skillet or microwave with a splash of water until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato chili
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes, then transfer to the slow cooker.
Cook the diced onions in the skillet until softened, about 5 minutes, then add to the slow cooker.
Add the garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, crushed tomatoes, and drained kidney beans to the slow cooker and stir well.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours, stirring once halfway through.
Portion into containers and top with cheese when serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions in a covered pot or microwave, adding a splash of water if thickened, until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato rice bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Brown the turkey and diced onions in a skillet over medium-high heat, about 10 minutes, then stir in the garlic powder.
In the baking dish, combine the turkey mixture, uncooked brown rice, chicken broth, and crushed tomatoes.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Uncover, top with mozzarella, bake 5 to 10 minutes until melted, then cool and portion.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, or in a 350 F oven until hot throughout.

proposal.explanation: Three batch dishes built around raw andouille sausage (catalog id andouille-raw), which is cooked fully in each recipe. Pantry availability for andouille-raw is treated as availability only, and all quantities are full-batch amounts for 6 servings. No prices are included.

dishes.title: Andouille and Kidney Bean Stew
steps: Slice the raw andouille into half-inch rounds.
Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the sausage for 5 to 6 minutes, until cooked through to an internal temperature of 165 F. Remove and set aside.
Lower heat to medium, then cook the chopped onion and bell pepper for 6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cumin for 30 seconds, then add the crushed tomatoes, drained kidney beans, chicken broth, and salt.
Return the sausage to the pot, bring to a simmer, and cook uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Adjust salt and serve hot.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate for up to 4 days. Reheat covered over medium-low heat with a splash of broth, stirring until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Andouille and Rice Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Slice the raw andouille into rounds, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, and brown the sausage until cooked through to an internal temperature of 165 F.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and celery to the skillet and cook 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Spread the rice in the baking dish, then add the sausage and vegetables, chicken broth, smoked paprika, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 45 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove foil, top with cheddar if using, and bake uncovered 5 minutes until melted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Reheat individual portions in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, adding a spoonful of water if dry.

steps: Slice the raw andouille into rounds and brown in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through to an internal temperature of 165 F. Drain excess fat.
Transfer the sausage to the slow cooker. Add the chopped onion, jalapeño, garlic, drained beans, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 7 hours or high for 3.5 hours, stirring once halfway through.
Adjust seasoning and serve topped with cheese if using.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
steps: Pat beef dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear beef in batches until browned, then transfer to the slow cooker.
Saute onion, garlic, carrot, and celery in the same skillet for 4 minutes, then add tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Transfer vegetables to the slow cooker with beef, potatoes, broth, thyme, and bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until beef is tender. Remove bay leaves, adjust seasoning, and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours in airtight containers up to 4 days; reheat covered on the stovetop over medium heat with a splash of broth until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey Black Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the turkey, breaking it apart, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and cook 4 minutes, then add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika and stir 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, drained black beans, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat in a pot over medium heat, stirring, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Baked Chicken Thigh and Potato Casserole
dishes.appliance: 9x13 inch baking dish in oven at 425 F
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F.
Thinly slice potatoes and toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper; spread in a greased 9x13 dish.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces, toss with remaining olive oil, minced garlic, and Italian seasoning, and arrange over potatoes.
Pour broth around the edges, cover with foil, and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes more until chicken reaches 165 F and potatoes are tender. Top with cheese in the last 3 minutes if using.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool, portion, and refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat individual portions covered in the microwave 2 to 3 minutes or in a 350 F oven until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Dice the onion and sweet potatoes; mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato batch pot (4 servings)
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains; drain excess fat.
Add onions and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic and ground ginger for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and salt; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, stir in shredded cheddar until melted, and portion into four containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low with a splash of water, stirring until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato chili (4 servings)
steps: Heat olive oil in the pot over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground turkey until cooked through; drain excess fat.
Add onions and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans and salt; simmer partly covered 25 minutes.
Portion into four containers and top with cheddar when serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered over medium heat, adding a splash of water if thick, until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato baked pasta (4 servings)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F. Cook pasta until just shy of al dente; drain.
Heat olive oil in a large pot; brown ground turkey and drain excess fat.
Add onions and cook 5 minutes; stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and salt; simmer 5 minutes, then fold in pasta.
Spread into the baking dish, top with cheddar and mozzarella, and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.
Cool, portion into four containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months. Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave 2 to 3 minutes, stirring halfway, or bake covered at 350 F for 20 minutes.

proposal.explanation: Three six-serving, reheatable batch meals designed for a deep skillet; none requires a separate oven step.

dishes.title: Tomato Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Cook the rice separately according to package directions; keep warm while making the curry.
Heat the oil in the deep skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, coconut milk, broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in spinach in handfuls until wilted. Simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes to thicken, then serve over rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate rice and curry promptly in covered containers. Reheat portions until steaming hot in the microwave or gently in the skillet; add a splash of water or broth if the curry has thickened.

dishes.title: Beef and Black Bean Skillet Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains, about 7 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add onion and bell peppers; cook until beginning to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, black beans, broth, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Cover, lower heat, and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring every few minutes. Uncover for the last 5 minutes if you prefer a thicker chili; check that it is steaming throughout before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in shallow covered containers. Reheat a portion in the microwave, stirring halfway, or warm gently in the skillet with a little water until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Smoky Sausage, Potato, and Cabbage Skillet

ingredients.displayName: Green cabbage, cored and cut into wedges

steps: Heat oil in the deep skillet over medium heat. Brown the sausage slices for 4 to 5 minutes, then transfer them to a plate.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Stir in garlic and smoked paprika for 30 seconds.
Stir in broth, mustard, salt, and pepper. Add potatoes and nestle cabbage wedges on top; cover and bring to a simmer.
Lower heat and braise, covered, for 25 to 30 minutes, turning the cabbage once, until potatoes are fork-tender and cabbage is soft.
Return sausage to the skillet and simmer uncovered for 3 to 4 minutes until hot throughout. Spoon broth over the vegetables to serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Store in covered portions with some of the broth to keep the potatoes and cabbage moist. Reheat gently in a covered skillet or microwave, stirring or turning the pieces, until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Andouille, White Bean, and Cabbage Stew

ingredients.displayName: Canned Great Northern beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Cut the raw andouille into slices, add it to the pot, and cook, turning, until browned and its center reaches 160°F (71°C); verify with a food thermometer. Transfer sausage to a plate.
Cook the onion, celery, and carrots in the pot for 5 minutes, stirring. Add garlic, paprika, and thyme and stir for 30 seconds.
Add cabbage, broth, and crushed tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the beans and cooked sausage. Simmer uncovered for 10–15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the stew is hot throughout. Season with pepper.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered containers. Reheat portions on the stovetop, stirring, until steaming hot throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of broth, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot throughout; or microwave covered, stirring midway.

dishes.title: Andouille, Tomato, and Lentil Curry
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Slice the raw andouille and cook, turning, until browned and the center reaches 160°F (71°C), checked with a food thermometer. Transfer to a plate.
Cook onion in the skillet for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Bring to a gentle boil, cover, and simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted and the curry is hot throughout.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered containers. Reheat until steaming hot throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a covered saucepan over low heat, stirring and adding a little water or broth if thick; heat until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Andouille, Potato, and Pepper Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Slice the raw andouille. In a skillet over medium heat, cook it, turning, until browned and its center reaches 160°F (71°C), verified with a food thermometer. Transfer to a plate.
Toss potatoes, peppers, and onion with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and pepper in the baking dish. Pour in broth and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 35 minutes. Carefully remove the foil, stir in the cooked sausage, and bake uncovered for 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender and everything is hot.
Scatter cheese over the top and bake 5 minutes more to melt. Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave, or cover the dish with foil and warm in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Tomato-Lentil Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Rinse lentils and add them to the slow cooker with sweet potatoes, onion, carrots, garlic, tomatoes, oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and water.
Stir, cover, and cook on low for about 6 hours, until lentils and vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach, cover for 5 minutes to wilt, then taste and adjust salt. Portion into six containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly. Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway, or warm on the stovetop with a splash of water until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Turkey, Black Bean and Rice Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and peppers; cook 5 minutes. Add garlic and turkey and cook, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, rice, beans, tomatoes, water, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cover and simmer about 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and the chili is thick. Add a little water if needed; portion into six containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring once, or on the stovetop over low heat. Add a splash of water if the rice has thickened the chili.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Cauliflower Curry
steps: Cook rice separately: combine basmati rice and water in a covered saucepan, bring to a boil, then simmer on low until tender, about 15 minutes. Set aside.
Heat oil in the sauté pan over medium heat. Cook onion for 4 minutes, then stir in garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, coconut milk, and salt. Cover and simmer gently for 18–22 minutes, until cauliflower is tender. Serve over rice and divide among six containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Store rice and curry together or separately. Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring midway, or warm gently on the stovetop; add a splash of water if the sauce has thickened.

dishes.title: Lemon-Dill Salmon and Potato Bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice potatoes and toss with half the oil and some salt and pepper. Roast in a large baking dish for 25 minutes.
Add chopped broccoli, remaining oil and dill; toss and roast for 5 minutes.
Place salmon on top, season with remaining salt and pepper, and bake for 12–15 minutes, until the thickest portion reaches 145°F. Squeeze lemon over the finished dish and divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered with a splash of water until the salmon and vegetables reach 165°F.

dishes.title: Coconut Curry Salmon and Rice
steps: Cook the rice in water according to package directions.
Meanwhile, slice the onion and peppers. Heat oil in a deep skillet and cook the vegetables for 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder.
Add coconut milk, the measured water and salt; simmer for 5 minutes. Add salmon cut into large chunks and gently simmer for 8–12 minutes, until it reaches 145°F.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Divide curry and rice among six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered with a splash of water, stirring gently, until the curry and rice reach 165°F.

dishes.title: Tomato Salmon and White Bean Stew
steps: Dice onion and carrots and mince garlic. Heat oil in a large pot; cook onion and carrots for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and oregano for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, drained beans, salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes or until carrots are tender.
Cut salmon into large chunks and add to the pot. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes, until the salmon reaches 145°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently on the stovetop or in the microwave until the stew reaches 165°F.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct batch dishes for 6 servings with no dietary constraints, using olive oil and garlic from pantry availability and additional shopping ingredients; no prices stated.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and brown in batches in olive oil over medium-high heat; set aside.
Saute onions, celery, and garlic in the pot until softened, then stir in tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, thyme, and bay leaves; bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise over low heat for 60 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover, and simmer 45 to 60 minutes until tender.
Discard bay leaves, adjust seasoning, and cool before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat gently on stovetop with a splash of broth until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Black Bean and Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in stockpot and cook turkey until no longer pink, breaking it up.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add beans with liquid, crushed tomatoes, and broth; season with salt.
Simmer uncovered 30 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Cool and portion; top with cheddar when serving if desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, adding a little water if thick.

dishes.title: Baked Chicken Thigh and Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F and lightly oil a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Slice potatoes thinly and onion into rings; arrange in dish with minced garlic.
Toss chicken thighs in olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; place over vegetables.
Pour broth around the edges, cover with foil, and bake 35 minutes.
Uncover and bake 25 minutes more until chicken reaches 165 F and potatoes are tender.
Top with mozzarella if using and broil briefly until melted; cool before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat individual portions covered in the microwave or in a 350 F oven until hot throughout.

ingredients.displayName: Canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
dishes.appliance: Large lidded Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Rinse the rice. Cook it separately according to package directions while making the curry.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and brown in olive oil in batches in the Dutch oven; set aside.
Saute chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery in the same pot until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute, then add broth, bay leaf, and thyme, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to the pot, cover, and simmer over low heat for 1 hour.
Add cubed potatoes and simmer uncovered 40 minutes until beef and potatoes are tender. Remove bay leaf and adjust seasoning before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool fully, refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of broth.

dishes.title: Black Bean and Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the stockpot and brown ground turkey with chopped onion and bell peppers.
Add minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, drained black beans, and broth.
Simmer uncovered 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, and season with salt.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat on the stovetop over medium heat, adding water if thick.

dishes.title: Baked Chicken and Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 400 F and thinly slice potatoes.
Toss chicken cubes and potato slices with olive oil, minced garlic, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Spread in the baking dish, pour broth over, cover with foil, and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle cheddar, and bake 20 minutes more until chicken reaches 165 F and potatoes are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat covered at 350 F for 20 to 25 minutes until hot throughout.
