proposal.explanation: Three distinct six-serving batch meals use the catalog’s generic raw salmon entry without assigning a species. Salmon is added near the end of cooking to help it stay tender when reheated.

dishes.title: Salmon, Potato & Leek Stew
steps: Cut salmon into large chunks and refrigerate while preparing the stew.
Melt butter in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add leeks, carrots, and celery; cook until beginning to soften, about 6 minutes.
Add potatoes, broth, dill, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook until potatoes are nearly tender, 15–18 minutes.
Stir in milk and salmon chunks. Simmer gently, uncovered, until salmon is just opaque and flakes easily, about 5–7 minutes. Do not boil vigorously.
Cool promptly and refrigerate portions. Reheat gently on the stovetop over low heat, stirring carefully, just until steaming; avoid prolonged boiling so the salmon remains tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions gently on the stovetop over low heat until steaming, stirring carefully and avoiding a hard boil.

dishes.title: Tomato Salmon & Rice Casserole
dishes.appliance: Covered 9-by-13-inch baking dish in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
In the dish, stir together rice, crushed tomatoes, broth, onion, bell pepper, garlic, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake until the rice is nearly tender, about 40–45 minutes. Check that liquid remains; add a splash of water if the dish looks dry.
Cut salmon into bite-size chunks and nestle them into the rice. Cover again and bake until the salmon is just opaque and flakes easily and the rice is tender, about 10–15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, then divide into portions. Cool promptly and refrigerate. Reheat covered in a 325°F (165°C) oven with a spoonful of water until steaming, or microwave covered in short intervals.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered with a spoonful of water in a 325°F (165°C) oven until steaming; microwave portions covered in short intervals if preferred.

dishes.title: Coconut Salmon & Chickpea Curry
dishes.appliance: Large deep stovetop skillet with lid

ingredients.unit: cans (15 oz each), drained and rinsed

steps: Cut salmon into large cubes and keep chilled. Heat oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder; cook for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Add salmon and gently simmer until just opaque and flakes easily, about 5–7 minutes; avoid breaking up the fish with vigorous stirring.
Cool promptly and refrigerate portions. Reheat gently, covered, over low heat or in short microwave intervals, stirring carefully and stopping as soon as steaming.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently over low heat with the lid on, or microwave covered in short intervals; stir carefully and stop once steaming to avoid overcooking the salmon.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high; sear beef in batches until browned, then set aside.
Saute onions, carrots and celery 5 minutes; add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef, add broth, bay leaf and thyme; bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise on low 90 minutes.
Add potatoes and simmer uncovered 30 minutes until tender; remove bay leaf and adjust seasoning.
Cool, portion into containers and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low with a splash of broth until steaming hot throughout, about 15 minutes.

dishes.title: Black Bean Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in stockpot over medium; cook onions 5 minutes.
Add ground turkey and cook until no longer pink, breaking up.
Stir in garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add beans, crushed tomatoes and broth; season with salt.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool and refrigerate in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring, with a splash of water until hot throughout, about 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Carrots
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F.
Cut potatoes and carrots into 1-inch pieces; toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spread vegetables on sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Toss chicken with remaining olive oil, minced garlic, Italian seasoning and salt; add to pan.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and vegetables are tender.
Cool and portion into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a 350 F oven for about 15 minutes, or microwave in covered container 2 to 3 minutes until hot throughout.

proposal.explanation: All three batch meals use whole cardamom pods, not ground cardamom. Remove and discard the pods before serving; they infuse the dish but are not pleasant to bite into.

dishes.title: Cardamom Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered Dutch oven or heavy pot
steps: Rinse the rice and cook according to its package directions; keep warm.
Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, crushed cardamom pods, curry powder, and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook until the sweet potatoes are tender, 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove and discard all cardamom pods. Stir in spinach until wilted, then add lime juice. Serve with rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in sealed containers. Reheat curry gently on the stove or in the microwave until steaming hot, stirring and adding a splash of water if thick; reheat rice separately with a little water.

dishes.title: Cardamom Beef, Carrot and Barley Stew
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in batches, then transfer to a plate.
Add onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot. Add broth, cardamom pods, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook gently for 75 minutes.
Stir in barley, cover, and simmer until the barley and beef are tender, about 35–45 minutes. Add a little water or broth if the stew becomes too thick.
Remove and discard the cardamom pods and bay leaf. Taste and adjust seasoning; finish with parsley if using.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in shallow sealed containers. Reheat on the stove over medium-low heat, stirring often and adding broth or water as barley thickens, until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Cardamom Chicken and Lentil Tomato Stew
dishes.appliance: Large heavy-bottomed soup pot with lid

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Warm the oil in the soup pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chicken and cook, stirring, until the outside is no longer pink, about 4 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, cardamom pods, cumin, and coriander for 1 minute.

Add tomatoes, broth, lentils, carrots, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft and chicken is cooked through.
Remove and discard the cardamom pods. Stir in lemon juice and adjust seasoning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in sealed containers. Reheat gently on the stovetop or in the microwave until steaming hot, stirring well; loosen with a splash of broth or water if needed.

proposal.explanation: Three batch-friendly meals for six, made without tree nuts or dairy. Verify packaged broths, spices, and other products for allergen cross-contact before use.

dishes.title: Smoky Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew

ingredients.displayName: Dried brown or green lentils, rinsed

steps: Heat the oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and carrots; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in garlic, paprika, cumin, and thyme; cook for 30 seconds.

Add sweet potatoes, lentils, tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils and potatoes are tender.
Stir in kale, if using, and simmer uncovered until wilted, about 3 minutes. Taste and adjust salt before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers within 2 hours. Reheat portions on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring and adding a splash of water or broth as needed; heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey, Black Bean, and Tomato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed
Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add turkey and onion; cook, breaking up the meat, until the turkey is no longer pink, about 7 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in bell peppers and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Transfer the mixture to the slow cooker.
Add beans, tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours or LOW for 7–8 hours. Stir and check that the chili is bubbling hot throughout before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in shallow containers within 2 hours. Reheat on the stovetop over medium heat, stirring occasionally and adding a little broth if thick; heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Chicken, Rice, and Vegetable Bake
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch baking dish in a conventional oven

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Spread rice, onion, carrots, and broccoli in the dish. Mix broth, crushed tomatoes, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; pour evenly over the rice and vegetables.
Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer on top and press them lightly into the liquid. Cover the dish tightly with foil.

Bake for 55 minutes. Carefully uncover, stir the rice and vegetables around the chicken, then check that the rice is tender and the thickest chicken pieces reach 165°F (74°C). If needed, cover and bake for another 5–15 minutes, adding a little hot broth if the rice looks dry.
Let stand covered for 10 minutes before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours. Reheat covered in a microwave with a spoonful of water or broth, stirring partway through, until steaming throughout; check that chicken is hot in the center.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and brown in batches in olive oil over medium-high heat; set aside.
Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes; add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, bay leaf, and thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 30 minutes, then add potatoes and simmer 30 minutes more until tender.
Discard bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and cool before refrigerating in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat with a splash of broth, stirring until steaming hot throughout, about 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Black Bean Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the pot over medium-high heat and brown the turkey, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes until softened; add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, broth, and salt; bring to a simmer.
Drain and rinse the black and kidney beans, add them, and simmer uncovered on low for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool and refrigerate in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, adding a little broth if thick, until bubbling and hot throughout, about 8 minutes.

dishes.title: Chicken Thigh Curry Skillet
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, season with salt, and brown in olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and cook 4 minutes; add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and garam masala and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and coconut milk, cover, and simmer on low 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes, then cool and refrigerate in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over medium-low heat with a splash of water, stirring until piping hot throughout, about 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onion and peppers and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in the pot. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes, then add garlic and spices for 30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in tomatoes, beans, water and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey is cooked through and the chili thickens. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat portions until steaming hot, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Chicken, Potato and Carrot Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes and carrots into small bite-size pieces, slice the onion and mince the garlic.
Toss vegetables with half the oil, thyme, salt and pepper in a large baking dish. Roast for 20 minutes.
Toss chicken with the remaining oil and arrange over the vegetables. Bake for 25–30 minutes more, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the vegetables are tender.
Rest briefly, then divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered in the microwave or oven until the chicken reaches 165°F.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Rinse the rice. In a separate covered saucepan, bring rice and water to a boil, cover and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes; rest covered for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, dice the onion, mince the garlic and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat oil in the skillet and cook onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger and curry powder; stir for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted. Serve in six portions with the rice.

dishes.title: Fresh Ginger Turkey Tomato Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add ground turkey and cook until thoroughly browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add diced onions, minced garlic, and freshly grated ginger, cooking for another 3 minutes until aromatic.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 25 minutes.
Stir in grated cheddar cheese until melted and fully incorporated before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and adding a splash of water if the stew has thickened too much.

dishes.title: Turkey and Tomato Skillet Bake
steps: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat and brown the ground turkey.
Mix in chopped onions, minced garlic, and freshly grated ginger, sautéing until onions are translucent.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken slightly.
Top the mixture evenly with cheddar cheese and transfer the skillet to the oven to bake for 15 minutes until bubbly and golden.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and reheat in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes until warmed through.

dishes.title: Ginger Spiced Turkey Chili Soup
steps: Warm olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat.
Add ground turkey and cook until completely browned.
Stir in chopped onions, minced garlic, and freshly grated ginger, cooking until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes along with 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish each portion with shredded cheddar cheese.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a covered pot over medium heat on the stovetop until simmering, stirring occasionally.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Italian Sausage and Peppers
dishes.appliance: Rimmed casserole sheet pan in conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 425 F and place the rack in the upper-middle position.
Toss bell peppers, zucchini, and onion with 2 tbsp olive oil, half the garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper on the sheet pan.
Nestle sausage links among the vegetables and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, turning sausage once, until sausage reaches 160 F internal and vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Scatter the remaining garlic over the hot pan for the last 2 minutes, then cool 10 minutes and divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover portions loosely with foil and reheat in a 375 F oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or microwave covered for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato and Broccoli
dishes.appliance: Rimmed casserole sheet pan in conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 425 F with racks in the upper and lower thirds.
Toss sweet potato cubes with 2 tbsp olive oil, half the salt, and half the paprika, then spread on the sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Season chicken thighs with garlic, remaining paprika, remaining salt, pepper, and remaining olive oil.
Add chicken and broccoli to the pan, arranging chicken in a single layer, and roast 15 to 20 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F internal.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice chicken and divide with vegetables into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a 375 F oven for 15 minutes, or microwave covered for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring once, until chicken is steaming hot to 165 F.

dishes.title: Sheet-Pan Curried Chickpeas and Cauliflower
dishes.appliance: Rimmed casserole sheet pan in conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 425 F and place the rack in the middle position.
Pat chickpeas dry, then toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, curry powder, turmeric, and half the salt on the sheet pan.
Add cauliflower and onion wedges, toss with remaining olive oil, garlic, and remaining salt, and spread into a single layer.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, stirring once halfway, until cauliflower is browned at the edges and chickpeas are crisp.
Cool 10 minutes, then divide into four portions and top each with yogurt if using.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a 375 F oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or microwave 2 minutes; add yogurt after reheating rather than before.

dishes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef and Root Vegetable Stew
steps: Add potatoes, carrots, and onion to the slow cooker.
Toss beef with oil, tomato paste, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper; put over the vegetables. Add water and bay leaf.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours, until the beef is tender. Remove the bay leaf and stir.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in portions for up to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat covered on the stove or in the microwave until steaming hot; add a splash of water if thick.

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook 4 minutes; stir in garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 7 minutes. Stir in chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Add sweet potato, crushed tomatoes, beans, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cover.
Simmer 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potato is tender and turkey is fully cooked. Adjust thickness with a little water if desired.
Refrigerate portions promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat on the stovetop, stirring, until bubbling throughout; add water if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of water, stirring until hot throughout.

Stir in coconut milk, chickpeas, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Add spinach in handfuls and stir until wilted, about 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

Cool and refrigerate portions promptly for up to 4 days, or freeze curry separately from rice. Reheat curry covered in a skillet over low heat, stirring until hot; reheat rice with a sprinkle of water.

dishes.title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Dice the onion and sweet potatoes; mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a large pot. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, water and salt. Simmer covered for 25–30 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming hot, adding water if needed.

dishes.title: Chicken and Potato Braise
steps: Cut chicken into large pieces, potatoes and carrots into bite-size pieces, and dice the onion. Mince the garlic.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven and cook onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic and thyme and stir briefly.
Add chicken, vegetables, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 30–35 minutes, until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat to 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Coconut Red Lentil Curry
steps: Rinse lentils, dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat oil in a deep skillet and cook onion for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, turmeric and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, coconut milk, water and salt. Simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender; add water if needed. Stir in spinach until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat until steaming hot, thinning with water as needed.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct batch dishes for 6 servings with no dietary constraints, using olive oil and garlic from the pantry and additional shopping ingredients; no prices are invented.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high and brown beef in batches; set aside.
Reduce heat to medium, add onions, carrots, and celery and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over low heat 1 hour.
Add potatoes and simmer uncovered 45 minutes until beef and potatoes are tender. Remove bay leaves and adjust seasoning.
Cool completely, then portion into airtight containers and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low, adding a splash of broth if thickened, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Black Bean Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in stockpot over medium-high. Add turkey and cook until browned, breaking up pieces, about 6 minutes.
Add onions and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, drained black beans, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool completely, then portion into airtight containers and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of water, stirring until piping hot throughout.

dishes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Thigh Bake with Potatoes
dishes.appliance: Two rimmed sheet pans in oven
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F. Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Toss chicken thighs with remaining olive oil, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Spread potatoes on one pan and chicken on the other, then roast 40 to 45 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and potatoes are golden.
Squeeze lemon over the hot pan, cool completely, then portion into airtight containers and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a 375 F oven for 12 to 15 minutes until hot throughout, or microwave covered with a damp paper towel.

dishes.title: Tomato Lentil and Spinach Stew
steps: Warm oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion and carrots, stirring, until beginning to soften, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste; stir for 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes, broth, lentils, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer gently until lentils are tender, 30–35 minutes; stir occasionally and add a little water if needed.

dishes.title: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Coconut Curry
dishes.appliance: Large deep stovetop skillet with lid
steps: Heat oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes; add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in curry powder and turmeric for 30 seconds. Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth, and salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in kale and cook uncovered until wilted, about 3 minutes. Add lime juice if desired. Cool promptly and portion for storage.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring now and then until steaming hot. Add a little water if the curry has thickened.

Quantities are full-batch positive amounts. Pantry availability for andouille-raw does not confirm enough quantity, so the shopping list covers the full amount needed. No prices are stated.

dishes.title: Andouille and Kidney Bean Stew
steps: Slice raw andouille into 1/2-inch rounds.
Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add andouille and brown on all sides, about 6 minutes, then cook until the internal temperature reaches 160 F. Transfer to a plate.
Lower heat to medium. Add onion, bell pepper, and celery; cook 6 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in smoked paprika, thyme, and bay leaves for 30 seconds. Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, and kidney beans.
Return sausage to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaves, season with salt and black pepper, and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium heat with a splash of broth, stirring until steaming hot to 165 F.

dishes.title: Andouille White Bean Chili
steps: Cut raw andouille into 1/2-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in the stockpot over medium-high heat. Add andouille and cook 7 minutes, stirring, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 160 F. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion and bell pepper; cook 5 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano; cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, and both bean varieties. Return andouille to the pot.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Season with salt and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat in a covered pot over medium-low heat, adding a little water if thick, until steaming hot to 165 F.

dishes.title: Andouille Potato Cheddar Bake
dishes.appliance: 9x13-inch baking dish in oven preheated to 375 F
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F and grease a 9x13-inch dish.
Slice raw andouille into 1/2-inch rounds and brown in a skillet over medium-high heat until the internal temperature reaches 160 F. Drain on paper towels.
Layer half the potatoes, onion, and andouille in the dish. Repeat with remaining potatoes and sausage.
Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, then slowly add milk. Simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes. Whisk in eggs, half the cheddar, salt, and pepper.
Pour sauce over layers, top with remaining cheddar, cover with foil, and bake 35 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more until potatoes are tender and top is golden.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, or cover the dish and bake at 350 F for 20 minutes until hot to 165 F.

steps: Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and brown in batches, about 4 minutes per side, then set aside.
Lower heat to medium. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and coconut milk, scraping up browned bits.
Return chicken to the skillet, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through to 165 F.

dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months. Reheat covered over medium-low with a splash of water until steaming and hot throughout.

dishes.title: Cheesy Turkey and Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 400 F and lightly oil the baking dish.

Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook turkey, onion, and garlic until turkey is no longer pink, about 8 minutes. Stir in crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, and simmer 5 minutes.
Arrange half the potato slices in the dish, spread the turkey mixture over them, then top with remaining potatoes.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with cheddar, and bake 10 to 15 minutes until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted and bubbly.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool, cover, and refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze portions up to 2 months. Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, or in a 350 F oven for 20 minutes until hot throughout.

proposal.explanation: Three reheatable six-serving meals, with no dairy ingredients, garnishes, or finishing fats.

dishes.title: Smoky Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili
dishes.appliance: Large heavy-bottomed pot on the stovetop

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and bell peppers for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook for 30 seconds.

Add sweet potatoes, crushed tomatoes, black beans, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer gently for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in lime juice if using. Taste and adjust seasoning. Add cilantro at serving if desired.

Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in sealed portions for up to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring and adding a splash of water or broth if thick; heat until steaming throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop, stirring often; loosen with a little water or vegetable broth as needed.

dishes.title: Tomato-Braised Chicken, Chickpeas, and Greens

ingredients.displayName: Kale, chopped with tough stems removed

steps: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in batches for about 3 minutes per side; transfer to a plate.
Add onion and carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, oregano, paprika, salt, and pepper. Return chicken and any juices to the pot; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook over low heat for 35–40 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and tender. Stir in kale and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until wilted. Stir in lemon juice if desired.
Cool leftovers promptly and store in sealed portions in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, or freeze. Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring occasionally, until steaming throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm covered over low heat with a small splash of broth or water; stir gently so the chicken stays in pieces.

dishes.title: Coconut Lentil and Vegetable Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered sauté pan or deep skillet on the stovetop
steps: If serving with rice, cook it separately according to package directions.
Heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric; stir for 30 seconds.

Add rinsed lentils, coconut milk, vegetable broth, cauliflower, and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft and cauliflower is tender.
Stir in spinach and cook uncovered for 2 minutes until wilted. Add lime juice if desired; taste and adjust salt.

Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in sealed portions for up to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring occasionally and adding water or broth if needed; heat until steaming throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat slowly on the stovetop, stirring often and adding a splash of water or broth to restore a saucy texture.

proposal.explanation: Here are three six-serving batch meals using fresh ginger, which is not currently marked available and should be added to the shopping list. Ground ginger is not used as a substitute.

dishes.title: Fresh-Ginger Chicken and Chickpea Coconut Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered skillet or Dutch oven
steps: Cook the basmati rice according to package directions.
Heat oil in the skillet. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes; stir in garlic, fresh ginger, and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and salt; cook, stirring, until the exterior is no longer raw, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, coconut milk, and chickpeas. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 20–25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Serve curry over rice. Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat curry and rice separately, covered, in the microwave until steaming hot, stirring midway; add a splash of water to the rice if dry.

dishes.title: Gingered Beef, Barley, and Root Vegetable Stew
steps: Put beef, barley, carrots, potatoes, onion, broth, fresh ginger, garlic, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker; stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for about 7 hours, until beef is fork-tender and barley is cooked. Stir and check tenderness; cook longer if needed.
Portion into containers. Cool promptly and refrigerate leftovers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion in a covered microwave-safe bowl until steaming hot, stirring halfway through. Stir in a little broth or water if the barley has thickened the stew.

dishes.title: Fresh-Ginger Turkey and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Heat oil in the pot. Add onion and cook 4–5 minutes until softened.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in garlic, fresh ginger, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, tomatoes, beans, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer and cover partially.
Simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chili has thickened. Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat or in the microwave, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot; loosen with a splash of broth or water if needed.

proposal.explanation: Generated three distinct 6-serving batch recipes utilizing an Instant Pot or slow cooker with specific methods.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Classic Beef Pot Roast
steps: Season the beef chuck roast generously with salt and black pepper on all sides.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Place peeled and chopped potatoes, carrots, sliced onions, and minced garlic at the bottom of the slow cooker insert.
Transfer the seared roast on top of the vegetables and pour the beef broth around the meat.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or until the beef is fork-tender and easily shreds.
Shred the beef directly in the slow cooker, mix with the tender vegetables and pan juices, then portion into meal prep containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions in a microwave-safe dish for 3 minutes, stirring halfway through, or gently warm in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of water.

dishes.title: Instant Pot Hearty Black Bean and Chicken Stew
steps: Turn on the Instant Pot and select the Sauté function. Add olive oil, chopped onions, and minced garlic, cooking until softened for about 3 minutes.
Add the chicken breasts, black beans, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, chili powder, ground cumin, and salt into the inner pot.
Secure the lid, ensure the steam release valve is set to Sealing, and select Pressure Cook (or Manual) on High Pressure for 15 minutes.
Once the cooking cycle completes, allow a natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then carefully quick-release any remaining pressure.
Remove the cooked chicken breasts, shred them using two forks, and return the shredded meat back into the stew.
Stir thoroughly, adjust seasoning to taste, and divide into six batch containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a covered saucepan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, or microwave in a covered bowl on high for 3 to 4 minutes.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Shoulder and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season evenly with salt, smoked paprika, and dried rosemary.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the pork chunks on all sides.
Place cubed peeled sweet potatoes, sliced onions, and minced garlic into the bottom of the slow cooker.
Arrange the browned pork chunks over the sweet potatoes and pour the vegetable broth evenly over everything.
Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 7 hours until the pork is melt-in-your-mouth tender and sweet potatoes are soft.
Lightly mash some of the sweet potatoes into the broth to thicken the sauce, mix gently, and divide into six individual batch portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a microwave-safe container on medium-high power for 3 minutes, stir, and heat for an additional 1 to 2 minutes until piping hot throughout.

dishes.title: Tomato-Ginger Chickpea Pot
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onions until softened, about 7 minutes; add garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cook uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve as is or top portions with cheddar.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in airtight portions. Reheat gently on the stovetop or microwave, stirring; add a splash of broth or water if thick.

dishes.title: Chickpea Tomato Chili with Peppers
steps: Put chickpeas, tomatoes, onion, bell peppers, garlic, oil, chili powder, cumin, broth, salt, and pepper in the slow cooker; stir to combine.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for about 4 hours, until the peppers are tender and the chili is thick. Taste and adjust seasoning.
For a thicker texture, mash a small scoop of chickpeas against the side and stir them back in.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and portion into airtight containers. Reheat in a saucepan over medium-low heat or microwave, stirring halfway through; loosen with a little broth if needed.

dishes.title: Baked Chickpea, Tomato and Cheddar Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Warm oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook onion for 6–8 minutes until soft, then stir in garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Stir in tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and chickpeas. Simmer for 8 minutes, then transfer to a 9-by-13-inch baking dish and cover with cheddar.
Bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes, until bubbling at the edges and the cheese is melted. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Store cooled portions in airtight containers. Reheat covered in a 350°F oven until hot through, or microwave in short intervals; add a spoonful of water if the edges seem dry.

steps: Dice the onion and sweet potatoes; mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a large pot. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and spices for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth and salt. Simmer covered for 25–30 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat portions until steaming hot, adding a splash of water if thick.

dishes.title: Chicken and Potato Tray Bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes and carrots into small chunks, slice onion and mince garlic.
Toss vegetables with half the oil and seasonings; spread on two large baking sheets. Roast for 15 minutes.
Coat chicken with remaining oil and seasonings. Add to the sheets and roast for 25–30 minutes, until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat covered in the microwave or oven until the chicken reaches 165°F.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Dice onion, mince garlic, and drain and rinse chickpeas.
Heat oil in a deep skillet. Cook onion for 5 minutes; add garlic and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk, tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat gently until steaming hot, stirring and adding water if needed.

dishes.title: Salmon and Chickpea Tomato Curry
dishes.appliance: Wide, deep lidded skillet on the stovetop
steps: Heat the oil in the skillet and cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt. Simmer uncovered for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cut salmon into large chunks, nestle into the sauce, cover, and gently cook until just opaque and cooked through, about 7–9 minutes. Cool promptly in shallow containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave or gently in a small pan, stirring the sauce and heating just until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Salmon, Barley and Vegetable Bake
dishes.appliance: Oven, 190°C (375°F), in a covered 3-quart casserole dish
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (375°F). In the casserole dish, combine barley, broth, mushrooms, onion, thyme, salt, pepper and oil. Cover tightly with a lid or foil.
Bake for 45 minutes, until the barley is nearly tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.

Stir in spinach and lemon juice. Place salmon in large chunks over the barley, cover again, and bake 10–15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and barley is tender. Rest briefly, then portion and cool promptly.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, adding a spoonful of water or broth if the barley seems dry; heat until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Slow-Cooker Turkey, White Bean, and Tomato Stew

ingredients.displayName: Canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it into small pieces, about 6 minutes; drain excess fat if needed.
Transfer turkey to the slow cooker. Add beans, tomatoes, onion, carrots, garlic, broth, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; stir.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours, until the carrots are tender and the stew is hot throughout.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat portions until steaming hot, stirring partway through.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of broth, stirring occasionally, until steaming hot; or microwave covered, stirring halfway through.

dishes.title: Smoky Three-Bean Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Canned black beans, drained and rinsed
Canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover.
Simmer gently for 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and the chili is thick.
Cool promptly and store in shallow containers. Reheat portions until steaming hot, stirring to heat evenly.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and adding a little broth or water if thick; alternatively microwave covered, stirring halfway through.

dishes.title: Chicken, Broccoli, and Brown Rice Bake
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch oven-safe casserole dish and conventional oven

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil the casserole dish.
In a bowl, stir together uncooked rice, broth, milk, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper. Spread evenly in the dish.
Arrange chicken pieces across the rice mixture and cover tightly with foil. Bake for 40 minutes.
Uncover, stir in broccoli and 1 cup of the cheese, then cover again and bake for 10 minutes. Check that chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and rice is tender; bake a little longer if needed.
Sprinkle on the remaining cheese and bake uncovered for 5 minutes to melt. Rest 10 minutes before portioning; refrigerate leftovers promptly in shallow containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot throughout, or microwave covered, stirring once; add a spoonful of broth or milk if the rice has dried out.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
steps: Rinse rice. Combine it with 3 cups water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low until tender, about 15 minutes; set aside.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir spinach into the curry until wilted, then add lime juice. Serve with rice. For batch storage, cool rice and curry promptly and store separately in meal-sized containers.
Reheat curry and rice separately, covered, in the microwave or on the stovetop; stir and heat until steaming hot throughout. Add a little water to the rice before reheating if dry.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool rice and curry promptly, refrigerate within 2 hours, and use within 3–4 days. Reheat each until steaming hot throughout; do not repeatedly reheat the full batch.

dishes.title: Salmon, Broccoli, and Rice Bake

ingredients.displayName: Raw Atlantic salmon fillets, skin removed and cut into chunks

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. In a saucepan, combine brown rice and water. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer until tender, about 35–40 minutes; drain any excess water.
Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch casserole dish. Steam or microwave broccoli just until bright green and barely tender, about 3–4 minutes.
In a bowl, stir together yogurt, vegetable broth, Dijon, lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper. Fold in cooked rice, broccoli, and salmon chunks. Transfer to the dish and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes, until the casserole is bubbling and salmon is opaque and flakes easily. Let stand 5 minutes before portioning.
Cool promptly and refrigerate portions. Reheat covered in the microwave or in a 350°F oven until steaming throughout; avoid overheating the salmon.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 days. Reheat individual portions covered until steaming hot throughout; a teaspoon of water or broth helps keep the rice moist.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Ginger Pot
steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add turkey and onions; cook, breaking up the meat, until turkey is no longer pink and onions soften, about 8 minutes.
Stir in garlic and ground ginger for 30 seconds. Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper; bring to a simmer.
Cover partly and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Check turkey is thoroughly cooked, then stir in the cheddar until melted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in portions. Reheat covered on the stovetop over low heat or in the microwave, stirring halfway through; add a splash of water if thick.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Ginger Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed soup pot over medium heat. Brown the turkey with the onions, breaking it up, for about 8 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes, beans, salt, and 1 cup water; bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and turkey is fully cooked. Stir in cheddar until melted.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions gently in a covered pot or microwave, stirring midway. Add a little water to loosen the chili; heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Cheddar Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Dice onions and mince garlic. Cook pasta in salted boiling water until just shy of tender; drain.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Brown turkey with onions, breaking it up, about 8 minutes. Stir in garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper; simmer 10 minutes, confirming turkey is fully cooked. Fold in the drained pasta.
Transfer mixture to a 2-quart baking dish, cover with foil, and bake 20 minutes. Uncover, top with cheddar, and bake 5 minutes more until melted and bubbling.
dishes.reheatTip: Store in covered portions. Reheat covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot throughout, or microwave with a splash of water; keep covered to prevent drying.

dishes.title: Turkey and Bean Chili
steps: Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook 4 minutes until softened.
Add the ground turkey and cook 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt, and cook 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, drained beans, and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover partly, and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Cool, portion into six containers, and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a saucepan over medium heat, adding a splash of water or broth, until steaming hot throughout (165°F).

dishes.title: Chicken Thigh Coconut Curry

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat the canola oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes until browned on the edges.
Add the diced onion and cook 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the ground ginger, curry powder, garam masala, and salt, and cook 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and crushed tomatoes. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (165°F).
Stir in the spinach, if using, until wilted. Cool and portion into six containers, then refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over medium-low heat with a splash of water, stirring until steaming hot throughout (165°F).

dishes.title: Beef and Potato Stew
dishes.appliance: 6-quart Dutch oven, stovetop then oven at 325°F
steps: Toss the beef cubes with the flour and salt.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 8 minutes total. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining olive oil, onion, and carrots, and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, thyme, garlic powder, and black pepper, and cook 1 minute.
Return the beef to the pot, add the broth and bay leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven at 325°F for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes, cover, and braise 45 minutes more until beef and potatoes are tender.
Discard bay leaves, cool, portion into six containers, and refrigerate.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of broth, stirring gently until steaming hot throughout (165°F).

dishes.title: Tomato-Lentil and Spinach Curry
dishes.appliance: Large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot
steps: Heat oil in the pot over medium heat. Add onions and cook until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, curry powder, and cumin; cook 1 minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 20–25 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and spinach; simmer until spinach wilts, 3–4 minutes. Season with pepper and additional salt to taste.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered on the stove over low heat or in the microwave, stirring midway; add a splash of water or broth if thick.

dishes.title: Smoky Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion and bell pepper until beginning to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Transfer vegetables to the slow cooker. Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt; stir.
Cover and cook on low for about 6 hours, until sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in lime juice before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a microwave or saucepan until steaming hot, stirring occasionally; loosen with a little broth if needed.

dishes.title: Chicken, Mushroom and Barley Stew

ingredients.displayName: Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in batches, about 3 minutes per batch; transfer to a plate.
Add onion, carrots, celery, and mushrooms; cook until softened and mushrooms release their liquid, about 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.

Return chicken and any juices to the pot. Stir in barley, broth, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently until barley is tender and chicken is cooked through, about 45–50 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf and check seasoning. Add a little water or broth if the stew has become thicker than desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered saucepan or microwave, stirring periodically; add broth or water as barley thickens during storage.

dishes.title: Hearty Turkey and Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Cook ground turkey until browned, about 6 minutes, then add onions and cook until soft.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth; season with salt.
Simmer uncovered 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Cool, portion into containers, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of broth until steaming throughout, about 5 minutes.

dishes.title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Potato Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F.
Toss potatoes, onions, and peppers with olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes, add sausage, and roast 15 minutes more until potatoes are tender and sausage is hot.
Cool completely, portion, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in a 350 F oven for about 15 minutes, or microwave until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Coconut Curry
dishes.appliance: Large skillet with lid on stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, and salt; simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and simmer 3 minutes more.
Cool, portion, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered in a skillet or microwave with a splash of water until hot throughout, about 5 minutes.

proposal.explanation: Three gluten-free, dairy-free batch meals. Check packaged ingredients and spice blends for gluten and dairy, and use clean cooking equipment.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Dice the onion and peppers and mince the garlic. Heat oil in a Dutch oven; soften the onion and peppers for 5 minutes.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Add garlic, cumin and chili powder; stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, water and salt. Simmer uncovered for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Ensure the turkey reaches 165°F (74°C), then divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 3–4 days, or freeze. Reheat until steaming hot and 165°F (74°C), adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Rinse rice. In a covered saucepan, bring the rice and water to a boil, then simmer on low for about 15 minutes. Rest covered for 10 minutes and fluff.
Meanwhile, dice onion and mince garlic. Heat oil in a deep skillet and soften onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk and salt; simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted. Divide curry and rice into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate rice promptly, ideally within 1 hour, alongside the curry; refrigerate for up to 3–4 days or freeze. Reheat to 165°F (74°C), adding a little water if dry.

dishes.title: Chicken, Potato and Carrot Bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut potatoes and carrots into small, roughly 2 cm pieces; slice onion and mince garlic.
Toss vegetables with half the oil, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper in a large baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes.
Toss chicken with remaining oil and place on the vegetables. Bake for another 25–30 minutes, until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C). Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 3–4 days, or freeze. Reheat covered until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).

dishes.title: Garlic Olive Oil Chicken and Rice Skillet
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Mince the fresh garlic and add to the pan along with diced chicken breasts, cooking until chicken is lightly browned.
Stir in the dry basmati rice, chicken broth, and salt, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Cover with a tight-fitting lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet or microwave with a splash of water to keep the rice moist.

dishes.title: Simple Garlic Olive Oil Potato Stew
steps: Peel and chop the fresh potatoes into bite-sized chunks.
Warm olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the potatoes and vegetable broth, season with black pepper, and bring to a rolling boil.
Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are fork-tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Simmer gently on the stovetop over low heat, stirring occasionally until heated through.

dishes.title: Garlic Olive Oil White Bean Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a baking dish, combine rinsed cannellini beans, crushed tomatoes, olive oil, minced garlic, and salt.
Stir well to evenly distribute the ingredients.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes until bubbling and slightly thickened.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 15-20 minutes until warm.

dishes.title: Turkey Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, drained beans, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, partially cover, and simmer 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Cool, portion into airtight containers, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions in a covered pot or microwave until steaming hot throughout, adding a splash of water if thick.

dishes.title: Turkey Sweet Potato Coconut Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Add turkey and cook until browned, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and cook 3 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, chicken broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat 15 minutes, until sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes. Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of broth or water, or microwave in covered container until hot.

dishes.title: Turkey Zucchini Rice Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F and lightly grease the baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook turkey until no longer pink, about 6 minutes. Add onion and cook 3 minutes, then add garlic and zucchini and cook 2 minutes.
Spread the mixture in the baking dish. Add uncooked rice, chicken broth, Italian seasoning, and salt, and stir to combine.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 60 minutes, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Uncover, sprinkle cheddar over the top, and bake 5 minutes more until melted. Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes, or in a 350 F oven covered with foil until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Slow Cooker Chickpea Chili

ingredients.displayName: Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained

steps: Soak dried chickpeas in water overnight, then drain and rinse.
Dice onion and bell pepper; mince garlic.
Add chickpeas, onion, bell pepper, garlic, tomatoes, broth, and spices to the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours until chickpeas are tender.
Stir well, adjust salt, and serve hot.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat portions in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of broth.

dishes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Coconut Curry

ingredients.displayName: Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight, simmered until tender

steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight, drain, then simmer in fresh water for about 1 hour until tender; drain.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; cook onion until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder; stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, then stir in chickpeas, coconut milk, and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat covered in a skillet over low heat, adding a splash of water if thick.

dishes.title: Baked Chickpea and Sweet Potato Casserole

ingredients.displayName: Dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and simmered until tender

steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight, drain, and simmer in fresh water about 1 hour until tender; drain.
Preheat oven to 400°F (204°C).
Toss sweet potato cubes with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt; roast on a sheet pan 25 minutes.
Cook onion in remaining oil until soft; stir in cumin, cinnamon, tomatoes, chickpeas, and roasted sweet potatoes.
Transfer to a 9x13-inch dish, top with mozzarella if using, and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until bubbling.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat individual portions in the microwave or covered in a 350°F oven until hot.

dishes.title: Classic Beef Stew with Potatoes and Carrots
dishes.appliance: 6-quart Dutch oven on stovetop, lid on, then oven at 325F
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high; brown beef in batches and set aside.
Cook onions and garlic in same pot until softened, about 5 minutes; stir in tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef, add broth, bay leaf and thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in oven at 325F for 1.5 hours.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover, and braise 30 to 40 minutes more until tender. Adjust seasoning and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours; reheat covered on stovetop over medium-low with a splash of broth to 165F.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey and Bean Chili
dishes.appliance: 6-quart Dutch oven on stovetop, lid partly open
steps: Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high; cook turkey until browned and no pink remains.
Add onions and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, cumin and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, and drained beans; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 60 to 75 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season with salt and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours; reheat on stovetop over medium with a splash of water to 165F.

dishes.title: Cheesy Baked Pasta Casserole
dishes.appliance: 6-quart Dutch oven, oven at 375F, uncovered for final bake
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until just al dente; drain.
In Dutch oven, brown beef with olive oil, then cook onions and garlic until soft.
Stir in tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 5 minutes.
Fold in pasta, half the mozzarella, and half the Parmesan.
Top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan; bake uncovered at 375F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours; reheat covered at 350F for 20 to 25 minutes or in microwave until 165F.

dishes.title: Tomato-Braised Beef, Potatoes, and Carrots
steps: Add beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, tomatoes, tomato paste, garlic, oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper to the slow cooker; stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef is tender and the potatoes are cooked through.
Cool promptly and divide into meal-sized containers. Refrigerate or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring once, until steaming hot; add a splash of water if the sauce has thickened.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Black Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Set the pressure cooker to sauté. Heat the oil, add turkey and onion, and cook, breaking up the meat, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and tomato paste; cook for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, bell peppers, beans, tomatoes, water, and salt. Stir, scraping the bottom of the pot clean.

Lock the lid and cook at high pressure for 8 minutes. Allow a 10-minute natural release, then carefully release remaining pressure. Stir and check that the turkey is fully cooked and sweet potatoes are tender.
Cool promptly and portion into containers. Use packaged spices and canned goods only if their labels are gluten-free.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through, until steaming hot. Add a little water if needed.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Cauliflower Curry
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander, and cumin; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and cauliflower. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes, then add chickpeas, coconut milk, and salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 20–25 minutes until the cauliflower is tender. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
Cool promptly and portion into containers. Check packaged ingredients for gluten-free labeling.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, or microwave covered until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Classic Beef Stew
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, then toss with flour.
Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high and brown beef in batches; set aside.
Sauté onions, carrots, and celery 5 minutes, add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to pot, add broth, thyme, and bay leaf; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low about 2 hours, adding potatoes during the last 30 minutes.
Remove bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and cool before refrigerating or freezing in portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions covered over medium-low heat with a splash of broth until steaming, about 10 to 15 minutes; microwave in 2-minute bursts if needed.

dishes.title: Turkey Black Bean Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in pot over medium-high and brown turkey, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add onions and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, black beans, broth, and salt; simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool and portion into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered over medium heat with a splash of water, stirring until hot throughout, about 8 to 10 minutes; microwave 2 to 3 minutes and stir halfway.

dishes.title: Baked Chicken and Rice Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook brown rice in broth with onion and oil until nearly tender, about 35 minutes; drain any excess liquid.
Season chicken with garlic powder, salt, and pepper and arrange over the rice with broccoli.
Cover and bake 30 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F.
Uncover, sprinkle with cheddar, and bake 5 minutes until melted.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover individual portions and microwave 2 to 3 minutes, or reheat the whole dish covered at 350 F for 20 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Slow-Cooker Chicken Black Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, cook onion 5 minutes, then add garlic, chili powder, and cumin for 1 minute.
Transfer onion mixture to the slow cooker with chicken, beans, tomatoes, broth, and salt.
Cover and cook on LOW 7 hours or HIGH 3.5 hours until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken in the pot with two forks and stir well. Adjust salt before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat portions in a covered pot over medium-low heat with a splash of broth, stirring until steaming, about 8 minutes, or microwave 2 minutes and stir.

dishes.title: Gluten-Free Beef and Vegetable Stew

ingredients.displayName: Raw beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high and brown beef in two batches, about 8 minutes total. Remove.
Lower heat to medium, cook onion, carrots, and celery 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot with broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 1 hour.
Add potatoes and simmer uncovered 35 minutes. Whisk cornstarch with 3 tbsp cold water, stir in, and simmer 3 minutes. Remove bay leaves before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat covered over medium-low heat, adding a splash of broth if thick, about 15 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook onion 5 minutes, then add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric for 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, and salt. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in spinach until wilted, about 3 minutes. Finish with lime juice if using.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat covered over medium-low heat with a splash of water, stirring until hot, about 8 minutes, or microwave 2 minutes and stir.

steps: Preheat oven to 425 F.

proposal.explanation: Generated three dairy-free batch meal recipes tailored to the target servings and pantry items.

dishes.title: Dairy-Free Chicken and Vegetable Stew
steps: Chop the onions, carrots, and potatoes into bite-sized pieces and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the boneless skinless chicken thighs and brown on both sides, then remove and dice.
Sauté the onions and garlic in the same pot until translucent.
Add carrots, potatoes, chicken broth, salt, black pepper, and the diced chicken back to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 35 minutes until vegetables are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered pot on the stove over medium-low heat until piping hot, adding a splash of chicken broth if needed.

dishes.title: Hearty Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes and onions. Mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onions and garlic until soft.
Add chili powder and ground cumin, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in cubed sweet potatoes, canned crushed tomatoes, and rinsed black beans.
Season with salt, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly heated through.

dishes.title: Roasted Vegetable and Quinoa Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Rinse the dry quinoa and combine it with vegetable broth in a pot, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Chop zucchini and bell peppers into bite-sized pieces and mince the garlic.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped vegetables and minced garlic with olive oil, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Mix the cooked quinoa and roasted vegetable mixture together in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the top is lightly golden and vegetables are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes until warm throughout, or microwave individual portions.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct, reheatable six-serving batch meals. Water is included as a cooking ingredient; no price claims are made.

dishes.title: Tomato Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet; cook onion for 5 minutes, then add garlic for 30 seconds. Transfer to slow cooker.
Add sweet potatoes, lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, water, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 6 hours, until lentils and sweet potatoes are tender. Stir and adjust seasoning before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in portions for up to 4 days. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring and adding a splash of water or broth if thick; microwave portions covered, stirring halfway.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Cauliflower Curry
steps: Warm oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder; stir for 30 seconds.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk, water, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover partly and simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender. Stir in spinach until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in portions for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if needed, or microwave covered and stir halfway through.

dishes.title: Smoky Sausage, White Bean and Cabbage Casserole

ingredients.displayName: Canned Great Northern beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Warm olive oil in a skillet and brown the sausage lightly; transfer it to the casserole dish.
In the same skillet, cook onion and carrots for 5 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and thyme, then add broth and scrape up any browned bits.
Combine cabbage, beans, sausage, and skillet mixture in the casserole dish. Season with salt and pepper, cover tightly, and bake for 45 minutes.
Stir, cover again, and bake another 15–20 minutes, until cabbage and carrots are tender. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in portions for up to 4 days. Reheat covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven until steaming hot, or microwave covered, stirring once; add a splash of broth if needed.

dishes.title: Beef, Barley & Root Vegetable Stew
steps: Pat beef dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat; brown beef in batches, about 8 minutes total, then transfer to a plate.
Add onions, carrots, and celery; cook 6 minutes, stirring. Add garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Return beef and any juices to the pot. Add broth, bay leaves, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently until beef is nearly tender, about 1 hour 30 minutes.
Stir in barley, cover, and simmer until barley and beef are tender, about 35–45 minutes. Add a little water or broth if the stew becomes too thick; remove bay leaves before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat portions on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring and adding broth or water as needed; heat until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Turkey, Bean & Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 7 minutes.
Add onions and bell peppers; cook 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, crushed tomatoes, beans, and broth. Stir, bring to a gentle boil, then cover and simmer 35 minutes.
Uncover and simmer another 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chili is thick. Adjust thickness with broth or water if needed.
dishes.reheatTip: Store in shallow containers and refrigerate promptly. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally and loosening with broth or water; heat until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Chickpea & Vegetable Coconut Curry
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and carrots; cook 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and tomato paste; stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 25–30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until cauliflower is tender.
Stir in spinach in batches and cook uncovered for 3–4 minutes until wilted. Simmer briefly uncovered if a thicker curry is desired.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently in a covered saucepan or Dutch oven over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally; add a splash of broth or water if thickened and heat until steaming hot.
