dishes.title: Garlic Chicken, Potatoes and Broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces and cut broccoli into florets. Mince garlic.
Toss potatoes and broccoli with 2 tablespoons oil, half the garlic and half the salt. Spread across two sheet pans, leaving room for chicken. Roast for 15 minutes.
Toss chicken with remaining oil, garlic, salt and paprika. Add to the pans and roast another 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F. Divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly for up to 4 days. Reheat a portion in the microwave until it reaches 165°F, stirring the vegetables halfway through.

dishes.title: Smoky Chickpea and Sweet Potato Sheet Pan
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces, chop peppers and onion, and drain and rinse chickpeas. Mince garlic.
Toss sweet potatoes, peppers, onion and chickpeas with oil, garlic, cumin, paprika and salt. Spread over two sheet pans.
Roast for 30–35 minutes, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are tender. Divide into four portions.
Mix tahini with juice from the lemon and enough water to make a pourable sauce. Store separately and drizzle over portions when serving.

proposal.explanation: Three reheatable six-serving batch meals; the recipes use garlic powder and do not use fresh garlic.

dishes.title: Garlic-Powder Beef, Barley and Vegetable Stew
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches, about 5 minutes total; transfer to slow cooker.
Add barley, carrots, celery, onion, potatoes, broth, tomato paste, garlic powder, thyme, and bay leaf. Stir to dissolve the tomato paste.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 7 hours, until beef and barley are tender. Remove bay leaf, taste and adjust seasoning. Divide into containers once cooled.
Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through, until steaming hot; add a splash of broth if thick.
dishes.reheatTip: Add a little broth before reheating; barley continues to absorb liquid as the stew stands.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add turkey and break it up with a spoon. Cook until no pink remains, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add sweet potato, tomatoes, broth, and beans; stir well.
Bring to a gentle boil, then cover partially and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potato is tender and chili has thickened.
Cool and portion for storage. Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 to 4 days, or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat or in the microwave, stirring once; loosen with a splash of broth if needed.

dishes.title: Chickpea, Spinach and Potato Coconut Curry
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring until softened.
Stir in curry powder, garlic powder, ground ginger, and tomato paste; cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook gently for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach in handfuls and cook uncovered for 3 to 5 minutes until wilted. Taste and adjust salt; cool and portion.
Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 to 4 days, or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered saucepan, stirring occasionally; add a little broth or water if the curry has thickened.

steps: Dice the onion and peppers and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes; add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Stir in chili powder and cumin.
Add tomatoes, beans, salt and water. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey reaches 165°F.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 4 days. Reheat to 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

steps: Dice the sweet potatoes and onion, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 4 days. Reheat to 165°F, adding water if the sauce is too thick.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onion and peppers and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes, then add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains. Stir in chili powder, cumin and salt.
Add tomatoes, beans and water. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat until steaming hot and 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken and Potato Bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes and carrots into 1-inch pieces, slice onion and mince garlic.
Toss vegetables with half the oil, half the oregano, salt and pepper. Spread in a large baking dish and bake for 15 minutes.
Toss chicken with remaining oil, oregano, salt, pepper, garlic and the lemon juice. Place over the vegetables.
Bake 25–30 minutes more, until chicken reaches 165°F and vegetables are tender. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat covered in the microwave or oven to 165°F; add a little water if dry.

dishes.title: Tomato Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes; add garlic and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat to 165°F on the stovetop or in the microwave, adding water if needed.

dishes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef, Barley, and Mushroom Stew
steps: Dice the onion, carrots, and celery; quarter the mushrooms and mince the garlic.
Put the beef, barley, vegetables, garlic, broth, tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper into the slow cooker. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 7 hours, until the beef is tender and barley is cooked. Remove the bay leaf and stir before serving.

Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered portions. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat or in the microwave until steaming hot; add a splash of broth or water if the barley has thickened the stew.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently with a splash of broth or water, stirring occasionally; barley thickens as it sits.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Black Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes. Dice the onion and bell pepper, and mince the garlic.
Warm the oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 minutes. Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; cook for 30 seconds.
Add the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, broth, and beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered portions. Reheat in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until bubbling, or microwave in covered portions until steaming hot.
dishes.reheatTip: Stir well while reheating; loosen with a little broth or water if the chili has become too thick.

dishes.title: Chicken, Broccoli, and Rice Bake
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch baking dish in a conventional oven
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Dice the chicken into bite-size pieces; finely dice the onion and mince the garlic. Cut the broccoli into small florets.

Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken, onion, salt, and pepper for 5–6 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside. Stir in the garlic and Italian seasoning for 30 seconds.
Spread the uncooked rice in the baking dish. Add the broth and milk, then stir in the chicken mixture and half the cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes.

Uncover, stir in the broccoli, cover again, and bake for 10–15 minutes more, until the rice is tender and chicken is cooked through. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top and bake uncovered for 3–5 minutes to melt.
Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate in covered portions. Reheat individual portions covered in the microwave until steaming hot, or reheat the covered dish in a 350°F oven until hot throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Keep portions covered while reheating so the rice stays moist; add a spoonful of broth or water if needed.

dishes.title: Beef Stew with Potatoes and Carrots
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high; sear beef in batches until browned, then set aside.
Lower heat to medium, cook onions 5 minutes, add garlic and tomato paste and stir 1 minute.
Return beef, add broth, thyme, and bay leaves; bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low 1 hour.
Add potatoes and carrots; simmer covered 40 to 50 minutes until tender.
Remove bay leaves, adjust seasoning, and divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low with a splash of broth until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Turkey Chili with Black Beans
steps: Heat olive oil in large pot over medium-high; brown turkey, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add onions and bell peppers; cook 5 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin; stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth, and salt; simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool and divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat in a covered pot over medium heat, stirring, until steaming hot throughout.

dishes.title: Baked Vegetable Lasagna Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F. Cook lasagna noodles to al dente and drain.
Heat olive oil in skillet; sauté zucchini and garlic 4 minutes, add spinach until wilted.
Combine crushed tomatoes with Italian seasoning and salt.
Layer noodles, tomato sauce, cottage cheese, vegetables, and mozzarella in baking dish; repeat once.
Top with Parmesan and bake covered 25 minutes, then uncovered 20 minutes until bubbling.
Cool and cut into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months; reheat individual portions covered in microwave 2 to 3 minutes or in a 350 F oven until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Ginger Chicken Thigh Stew
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with salt and black pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the chicken in batches, then set aside.
Sauté the diced onion, sliced carrots, minced garlic, and grated ginger for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Return the chicken to the pot, add chicken broth and soy sauce, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes until the chicken is tender and the carrots are soft.
Stir cornstarch into 3 tablespoons cold water, add to the pot, simmer 3 minutes to thicken, then stir in sesame oil before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within two hours and keep up to four days. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium heat with a splash of broth until steaming, about 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Sweet Potato Chickpea Curry
steps: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes into 3/4-inch pieces.
Heat olive oil in the skillet over medium heat and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potatoes, chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, coconut milk, and salt, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 20 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach and cook uncovered 3 minutes until wilted, then portion.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate within two hours for up to four days. Reheat in a covered skillet over medium-low heat with a splash of water, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes.

dishes.title: Black Bean Beef Chili
steps: Brown the ground beef in the stockpot over medium-high heat, breaking it apart, and drain excess fat.
Add diced onion and bell pepper and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add black beans, crushed tomatoes, beef broth, and salt, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Portion and top with cheddar cheese if using.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within two hours for up to four days. Reheat covered over medium heat, stirring and adding a little broth if thick, about 10 minutes.

proposal.explanation: Generated three distinct batch meal recipes using raw salmon fillets along with safe pantry and produce ingredients.

dishes.title: Salmon and Brown Rice Skillet Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, combine the dry brown rice, chicken broth, olive oil, and salt.
Toss in the chopped broccoli florets and stir to distribute evenly.
Nestle the raw salmon fillets into the rice mixture.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the rice is tender and the salmon flakes easily.
Fluff the rice around the baked salmon before portioning into batch containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Microwave covered with a damp paper towel on medium power for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through.

dishes.title: Hearty Salmon and Potato Chowder
steps: Melt the butter in a large stockpot over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and celery, sautéing until translucent.
Add peeled and diced Russet potatoes along with the vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are soft.
Cut raw salmon fillets into bite-sized chunks and gently stir them into the simmering soup.
Cook for an additional 6 to 8 minutes until the salmon is fully cooked through.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, or microwave in a covered bowl.

dishes.title: Salmon and Quinoa Stew Braise
steps: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sliced carrots, sautéing for 5 minutes.
Stir in the canned crushed tomatoes, dry quinoa, and 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
Lay the raw salmon fillets across the top of the simmering quinoa and vegetable mixture.
Cover and braise for 12 to 15 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the salmon is cooked through.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat in a microwave-safe container with a splash of water, covered, at 70% power for 3 minutes.

proposal.explanation: Three six-serving batch meals that avoid gluten and dairy. Pantry-listed olive oil and garlic are used; other ingredients can be shopped for.

dishes.title: Tomato-Garlic Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Put beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, and garlic in the slow cooker.
Stir together crushed tomatoes, water, olive oil, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper; pour over the beef and vegetables.
Cover and cook on low for 7 hours, until beef is fork-tender and potatoes are cooked through. Stir before serving.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway, until steaming hot; add a splash of water if the stew has thickened.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Black Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add turkey and onion; cook, breaking up the meat, until turkey is no longer pink, about 7 minutes.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt; cook for 30 seconds.

Add sweet potatoes, beans, crushed tomatoes, and water. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook gently for about 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and turkey is cooked through.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in individual portions. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low heat or in the microwave, stirring once; loosen with a little water if needed and heat until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea, Spinach, and Rice Bake
dishes.appliance: 9-by-13-inch casserole dish in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil the casserole dish.
In a bowl, stir together rinsed rice, chickpeas, spinach, onion, garlic, coconut milk, water, olive oil, curry powder, turmeric, and salt.

Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 55 minutes. Check that the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed; if needed, add a little hot water, cover, and bake for another 5–10 minutes. Rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff and serve.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in portions. Reheat covered in the microwave with a spoonful of water, stirring halfway through, until steaming hot; the rice also reheats well covered in a 350°F oven.

dishes.title: Lemon-Dill Salmon and Potato Bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Dice potatoes small and toss with half the oil and salt. Roast on a large sheet pan for 20 minutes.
Add chopped broccoli and the remaining oil; roast for 8 minutes.
Add salmon, season with dill and pepper, and roast 12–15 minutes, until the thickest part reaches 145°F (63°C). Squeeze lemon over the batch and divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered until hot throughout, adding a splash of water to keep the salmon moist.

dishes.title: Coconut Curry Salmon and Rice
steps: Cook rice with the water according to package directions.
Meanwhile, slice onion and peppers. Soften in oil in a large skillet for 5 minutes, then stir in curry powder.

Add coconut milk and salt and simmer for 8 minutes. Cut salmon into large chunks, add to the sauce, and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the thickest pieces reach 145°F (63°C). Stir in spinach until wilted.
Divide the rice and curry into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered until hot throughout, stirring gently and adding water if needed.

dishes.title: Tomato, White Bean and Salmon Stew
steps: Dice onion and carrots and mince garlic. Cook in oil in a large pot for 6 minutes.
Add oregano, pepper, tomatoes, broth, and drained, rinsed beans. Simmer for 15 minutes until carrots are tender.
Cut salmon into large chunks and add to the stew. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the thickest pieces reach 145°F (63°C). Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently until hot throughout, adding a little water if the stew has thickened.

steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic. Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat and soften the onions for 5 minutes.
Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Stir in garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate portions promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat until 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

steps: Dice onions, mince garlic, and drain and rinse beans.
Heat oil in a stockpot over medium heat. Cook onions for 5 minutes, then add turkey and brown, breaking it up.
Stir in garlic and spices. Add tomatoes, beans, water and salt; simmer for 25 minutes, until turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into six portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly for up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat to 165°F, stirring and adding water if thick.

dishes.title: Coconut Curry Salmon Skillet

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 2-inch pieces
Lime, cut into wedges for serving

steps: Pat the salmon dry and season lightly with salt.
Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook uncovered for 5 minutes.
Nestle the salmon pieces into the sauce, cover, and simmer on low for 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Fold in the spinach and cook 2 minutes until wilted. Cool, portion into airtight containers, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, adding a splash of water if thick. Serve with lime wedges. Do not boil hard.

dishes.title: Salmon and Potato Chowder

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Melt the butter in the Dutch oven over medium heat and cook the onion and celery for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the broth, then add the potatoes and simmer 12 minutes until tender.
Stir in the milk and dill and warm gently without boiling.
Add the salmon cubes and simmer on low for 5 to 6 minutes until just opaque. Season with salt and pepper, cool, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop over low-medium heat, stirring often, for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not let it boil after the milk is added, to prevent curdling.

dishes.title: Salmon Broccoli Cheddar Bake
dishes.appliance: 9x13-inch baking dish in a 400 F oven

ingredients.displayName: Raw salmon fillets, skinless, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Cook the brown rice according to package directions and let it cool slightly.
Preheat the oven to 400 F and lightly grease the baking dish.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until barely tender and drain.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, lemon zest, salt, and pepper together.
Spread the rice, broccoli, and salmon in the dish, pour the egg mixture over the top, and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes until set and the salmon is opaque. Cool, portion, and refrigerate within 2 hours.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat individual portions in the microwave at 70 percent power for 2 to 3 minutes, or cover and warm in a 325 F oven for 15 minutes until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Smoky Chickpea and Tomato Stew
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight in plenty of water. Drain and rinse.

Dice the onion and carrots and mince the garlic. In the pot, soften them in oil for 8 minutes; stir in paprika.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, broth and salt. Simmer 20 minutes, until the carrots are tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers within 2 hours. Reheat until piping hot, adding a splash of water if thick.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight in plenty of water. Drain and rinse.
Cover with 8 cups of the water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer 60–120 minutes until tender, adding water if needed. Drain.
Dice sweet potatoes and onion and mince garlic. Cook onion in oil for 5 minutes; add garlic and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, remaining 2 cups water and salt. Simmer 20–25 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Stir in spinach until wilted.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers within 2 hours. Reheat gently until piping hot, stirring in water if needed.

dishes.title: Chickpea, Barley and Vegetable Soup
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight in plenty of water. Drain and rinse.
Cover with the 8 cups water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer 60–120 minutes until tender, adding water if needed. Drain.
Dice the onion, carrots and celery. Soften them in oil in the pot for 8 minutes, then stir in thyme.
Add chickpeas, barley, broth and salt. Simmer 35–45 minutes until barley is tender, adding water if the soup gets too thick.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers within 2 hours. Reheat until piping hot; add water or broth as the barley absorbs liquid.

proposal.explanation: Three reheatable batch meals for six, all dairy-free. Butter, milk, and cheese are not used.

dishes.title: Coconut Red Lentil and Spinach Curry
dishes.appliance: Large lidded Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion for 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric; stir for 30 seconds.
Stir in lentils, coconut milk, broth, tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted. Cool promptly and refrigerate in sealed portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently on the stovetop or in the microwave, stirring halfway through; add a splash of water or broth if thick.

dishes.title: Smoky Black Bean and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion for 4–5 minutes. Stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Transfer onion mixture to the slow cooker. Add sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt; stir.
Cover and cook on low for 5–6 hours, until sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in lime juice if using. Cool promptly and refrigerate in sealed portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, or microwave covered; loosen with broth or water if needed.

dishes.title: Garlic, Tomato, and Chickpea Vegetable Stew
dishes.appliance: Large heavy-bottomed pot on the stovetop
steps: Warm olive oil in the pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in garlic for 30 seconds. Add zucchini, chickpeas, tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover, and simmer for 30–35 minutes until vegetables are tender. Remove the bay leaf. Cool promptly and refrigerate in sealed portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm on the stovetop over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, or microwave covered until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Andouille and White Bean Cassoulet Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown the raw andouille sausage thoroughly on all sides, then slice into rounds.
In a large baking dish, combine the rinsed cannellini beans, diced onions, minced garlic, browned andouille slices, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the baking dish with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes until the top is slightly golden and bubbly.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat portions in a covered skillet or microwave with a splash of chicken broth to retain moisture.

dishes.title: Smoky Andouille and Rice Skillet
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and thoroughly cook the raw andouille sausage until browned, then remove and slice.
In the same skillet, sauté diced onions, bell peppers, and minced garlic until soft.
Stir in the dry jasmine rice, smoked paprika, and sliced andouille sausage.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat, adding a tablespoon of water to loosen the rice.

dishes.title: Hearty Andouille and Potato Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Fully cook the raw andouille sausage links, then remove and slice into thick coins.
Add diced onions, sliced carrots, and chopped celery to the Dutch oven, cooking until slightly softened.
Peel and cube the Russet potatoes, then add them to the pot along with the sliced andouille.
Pour in the chicken broth and sprinkle in the dried thyme.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm gently in a pot over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent potatoes from sticking.

Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, garlic powder, and salt, then gradually whisk in milk to form a thick sauce.
Stir in 1.5 cups of shredded cheddar cheese until melted into the sauce.
Combine chicken and broccoli in the baking dish, pour cheese sauce over the top, and sprinkle the remaining cheese.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct four-serving sheet-pan meals with practical batch-cooking methods and reheating instructions.

dishes.title: Garlic-Herb Chicken, Potatoes, and Broccoli
dishes.appliance: Rimmed sheet pan in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment or lightly oil it.
Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil, half the garlic, half the Italian seasoning, and half the salt and pepper. Spread on the pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, toss chicken with 1 tablespoon oil and the remaining garlic, seasoning, salt, and pepper. Toss broccoli with the remaining oil.
Add chicken and broccoli to the pan, arranging in a single layer. Roast 20–25 minutes, turning the potatoes once, until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and potatoes are tender.
Cool promptly and divide into four meal containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in sealed containers for up to 4 days. Reheat a portion covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven for 15–20 minutes, or microwave covered in 60-second intervals until steaming hot; add a teaspoon of water before microwaving if the potatoes seem dry.

dishes.title: Smoky Sausage, Peppers, and Sweet Potatoes
dishes.appliance: Rimmed sheet pan in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
Toss sweet potatoes with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Spread on the pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Add peppers, onion, and sliced cooked sausage. Toss gently and spread everything into a single layer.
Roast another 18–22 minutes, stirring once, until sweet potatoes are tender and sausage is browned at the edges.
Divide into four containers and cool before refrigerating.
dishes.reheatTip: Keep covered in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven for 15 minutes, uncovering for the final 3–5 minutes to crisp the sausage, or microwave covered in 60-second intervals until hot throughout.

dishes.title: Lemon-Dill Salmon with Asparagus and Tomatoes
dishes.appliance: Rimmed sheet pan in a conventional oven
steps: Heat oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, dill, garlic, salt, and pepper. Toss asparagus and tomatoes with about half the mixture and spread them on the pan.
Place salmon on the pan among the vegetables and spoon the remaining mixture over the fillets.
Bake 12–16 minutes, depending on fillet thickness, until salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C) at its thickest point, and asparagus is tender.
Cool and portion into four containers, keeping the salmon portions intact.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 days. For gentler reheating, cover a portion and microwave at 50% power in 30-second intervals until just hot; avoid prolonged heating, which dries salmon. Alternatively, reheat covered in a 300°F (150°C) oven for about 10 minutes.

dishes.title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew
dishes.appliance: Dutch oven on stovetop or slow cooker
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and brown in olive oil in batches; set aside.
Saute onion, celery, and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes, then stir in tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot, add broth, thyme, and bay leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise 1.5 hours on low, or cook on low in a slow cooker for 6 to 8 hours.
Add carrots and potatoes, cook 30 minutes more until tender, then remove bay leaves and adjust seasoning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours, store up to 4 days, and reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of broth until steaming hot (165°F).

dishes.title: Black Bean and Turkey Chili
steps: Heat olive oil in a stockpot over medium heat and brown ground turkey, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chili powder and cumin for 30 seconds, then add crushed tomatoes, drained black beans, and broth.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, and season with salt.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool, refrigerate within 2 hours, and keep up to 4 days; reheat over medium heat, adding a little water if thick, to 165°F.

dishes.title: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Curry Skillet
dishes.appliance: Large deep skillet with lid on stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and saute onion, garlic, and ginger for 5 minutes.
Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds, then add cubed sweet potatoes, drained chickpeas, coconut milk, and broth.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted and season with salt.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 4 days; reheat covered over medium-low with a splash of broth until hot throughout (165°F).

dishes.title: Tomato, Lentil and Spinach Curry
dishes.appliance: Large covered skillet or Dutch oven
steps: Heat oil in a large covered skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onions for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, ginger and curry powder; cook for 1 minute. Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, coconut milk, salt and pepper.
Bring to a gentle boil, cover partially and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft. Add a splash of broth or water if it becomes too thick.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Meanwhile, cook rice according to its package directions. Portion curry with rice.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in airtight containers. Reheat curry and rice separately in the microwave, stirring halfway through; add a splash of water to the curry if thick. Heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: White Bean, Kale and Potato Tomato Stew

ingredients.displayName: Canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Fresh kale, stems removed and chopped

steps: Heat oil in the pot over medium heat. Add onion and carrots; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add garlic and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute. Add potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth, thyme, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes, until potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally.
Stir in kale and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until tender. Taste and adjust seasoning before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Store in airtight portions in the refrigerator. Reheat on the stovetop over medium-low heat or in the microwave, stirring occasionally; add a little water or vegetable broth if needed and heat until steaming.

dishes.title: Salmon, Broccoli and Rice Casserole

ingredients.displayName: Raw Atlantic salmon fillets, skin removed and cut into chunks

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. In a saucepan, combine rice and broth, bring to a boil, cover and simmer according to package directions until just tender. Transfer rice to a greased 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms for 5 minutes, then add garlic and broccoli and cook for 2 minutes. Spread vegetables over the rice and arrange salmon chunks on top.
Whisk milk, cornstarch, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper until smooth. Pour evenly over the casserole and sprinkle with cheddar.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake another 10–15 minutes, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily and the center is steaming. Rest 5 minutes, then portion.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in airtight portions promptly. Reheat gently in a covered microwave-safe dish, stirring rice and vegetables where possible, until steaming throughout; avoid prolonged heating so the salmon stays moist.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato batch pot
steps: Dice the onions and mince the garlic.
Brown the turkey in a large pot over medium heat, breaking it up. Add the onions and cook until softened.
Stir in the garlic and ginger, then add the tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the turkey reaches 165°F.
Divide into four portions and top with the cheddar.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat until steaming hot and 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Cheesy turkey tomato skillet
dishes.appliance: Stovetop and deep skillet with lid
steps: Thinly slice the onions and mince the garlic.
Brown the turkey in a deep skillet, breaking it up. Add the onions and cook until softened.
Add the garlic, ginger and tomatoes. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, until thick and the turkey reaches 165°F.
Sprinkle with cheddar, cover until melted and divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in a skillet or microwave to 165°F; add a little water if dry.

dishes.title: Turkey tomato cheddar bake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Dice the onions and mince the garlic.
In an oven-safe skillet, brown the turkey and soften the onions. Stir in the garlic, ginger and tomatoes; simmer for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top and bake for 15 minutes, until bubbling and the turkey reaches 165°F. Divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave or oven until the center reaches 165°F.

dishes.title: Beef, Potato and Carrot Braise
dishes.appliance: 7-quart or larger Dutch oven with lid
steps: Cut beef into large chunks; chop onions, garlic, carrots and potatoes.
Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, about 10 minutes total, then remove.
Cook onions for 5 minutes. Add garlic, tomato paste and thyme; stir for 1 minute. Add broth, salt and pepper, scraping up browned bits.
Return beef to the pot. Cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover and simmer 35–45 minutes more, until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked. Divide into eight portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat covered on the stove or in the microwave to 165°F, adding a splash of water if needed.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
dishes.appliance: 7-quart or larger Dutch oven with lid
steps: Dice onions and peppers, mince garlic, and drain and rinse beans.
Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Cook turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains, about 8 minutes.
Add onions and peppers and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add beans, tomatoes, broth and salt. Bring to a simmer, then cover partly and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Divide into eight portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat to 165°F on the stove or in the microwave, stirring and adding a little water if thick.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
dishes.appliance: 7-quart or larger Dutch oven with lid
steps: Dice onions and sweet potatoes into roughly 1-inch pieces; mince garlic. Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onions for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, broth and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Divide into eight portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers. Reheat gently to 165°F on the stove or in the microwave, stirring and adding water if needed.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct batch dishes for 6 servings, using dried garlic powder only because fresh garlic is unavailable. No dietary constraints were supplied, and no prices or offers are used.

dishes.title: Beef and Vegetable Stew
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper, then brown in oil in batches in the Dutch oven and set aside.
Saute onions and carrots in the same pot for 5 minutes, then stir in tomato paste and garlic powder for 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot, add broth, thyme and bay leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hour, then add potatoes and cook 45 minutes more until beef and potatoes are tender.
Remove bay leaves, adjust seasoning, and cool before portioning into containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat covered on the stovetop over medium-low, adding a splash of broth if thick.

dishes.title: Turkey Black Bean Chili
steps: Heat oil in the stockpot and cook turkey, onions and bell peppers until turkey is no longer pink.
Stir in chili powder, cumin and garlic powder for 1 minute.
Add beans, crushed tomatoes, broth and salt, then simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Adjust seasoning and cool before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat in a pot over medium heat, stirring and adding a little water if thick.

dishes.title: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat oil in the skillet and cook onions until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ginger, garlic powder and curry powder for 1 minute, then add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk and salt, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then cook rice separately according to package directions.
Cool curry and rice separately before portioning.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze curry up to 2 months. Reheat curry covered over medium-low with a splash of water; reheat rice with a damp towel in the microwave until steaming.

dishes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
steps: Dice the onion and peppers and mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook onion and peppers for 5 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.

proposal.explanation: Remixed the turkey-and-tomato batch pot without dairy and added two distinct dairy-free batch meals. All three make six servings and are suitable for reheating.

dishes.title: Dairy-Free Turkey Tomato Ginger Pot
dishes.appliance: Large Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add diced onions and cook until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add ground turkey and break it up with a spoon; cook until no longer pink, about 8 minutes. Drain excess liquid if needed.
Stir in minced garlic and ground ginger; cook 30 seconds. Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partly, and cook 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Check that the turkey is fully cooked and adjust seasoning.
Cool promptly and portion into containers. Refrigerate for up to 4 days or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through, or warm gently in a saucepan with a splash of water or broth until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Turkey, Black Bean and Tomato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion and bell pepper; cook 5 minutes. Add turkey and cook, breaking it apart, until no longer pink, about 8 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds. Transfer the mixture to the slow cooker.
Add drained beans, crushed tomatoes, water, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours. Taste and adjust seasoning before portioning.
Cool promptly, then refrigerate portions for up to 4 days or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring once, or in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add a little water if the chili has thickened; heat until steaming hot.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Vegetable Curry
dishes.appliance: Large lidded Dutch oven on the stovetop
steps: Heat olive oil in a large lidded pot over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and curry powder; stir for 30 seconds. Add cauliflower florets and stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, chickpeas, and salt. Stir and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is tender. Portion with the sauce and cool promptly.
Refrigerate portions for up to 4 days or freeze.
dishes.reheatTip: Warm gently in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, or microwave covered and stir halfway through. Add a splash of broth or water if needed.

proposal.explanation: Scaled the seed recipe from six to four servings (two-thirds quantities) and varied its turkey-and-tomato base across three reheatable meal styles.

dishes.title: Turkey, Tomato & Ginger Stew
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add turkey and break it up; cook until no longer pink, about 7 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover partially, and cook gently for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check that the turkey is fully cooked, then portion into four containers.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway through, or warm gently in a saucepan with a splash of broth.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook diced onion for 4–5 minutes, add turkey, and brown while breaking it up, about 7 minutes. Stir in minced garlic, ginger, chili powder, and cumin for 30 seconds.
Transfer the turkey mixture to the slow cooker. Add crushed tomatoes, drained beans, broth, and salt; stir to combine.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours. Confirm the turkey is fully cooked and the chili is bubbling hot, then divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring once, or warm in a saucepan over medium-low heat; add a little broth if it has thickened.

dishes.title: Turkey Tomato Cheddar Rice Bake
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a skillet, heat olive oil and cook diced onion for 5 minutes. Add turkey and brown, breaking it up, about 7 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Stir uncooked rice, broth, crushed tomatoes, and salt into the turkey mixture. Transfer to the casserole dish and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 40 minutes, then check that the rice is tender and turkey is fully cooked. If needed, add 2 tablespoons of water, re-cover, and bake 5–10 minutes more.
Sprinkle cheddar over the top and bake uncovered for 5 minutes to melt. Rest 10 minutes, then divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat a portion covered in the microwave until steaming hot, adding a splash of water if the rice seems dry.

proposal.explanation: Three distinct eight-serving Dutch-oven meals sized for a typical 6–7-quart pot. Ingredients beyond the listed pantry items may need to be purchased; no prices were supplied.

dishes.title: Beef, Potato, and Carrot Dutch-Oven Stew
steps: Heat the oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Season the beef with salt and pepper, then brown it in batches so the pot is not crowded; transfer browned beef to a plate.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef and accumulated juices to the pot. Add broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook gently for about 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Add carrots and potatoes. Cover and simmer 35–45 minutes, until the beef and vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaves. If thicker stew is desired, mix the optional cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water, stir it in, and simmer 2 minutes.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered on the stovetop over low heat, stirring occasionally and adding a splash of broth or water if thick. Heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Smoky Turkey, Bean, and Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 7 minutes.
Add onion and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook 30 seconds.

Add tomatoes, broth, beans, sweet potatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer 35–45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chili has thickened.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat covered over low heat on the stovetop, stirring now and then. Add a little broth or water if needed; heat until steaming throughout.

dishes.title: Coconut Chickpea and Red Lentil Curry
steps: Heat oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric; cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk, broth, and salt. Stir well and bring to a gentle simmer.

Cover partially and cook over low heat for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally so lentils do not stick, until lentils are soft and the curry is thick. Stir in spinach until wilted and finish with optional lime juice.
dishes.reheatTip: Reheat gently in a covered pot over low heat, stirring often. Lentils thicken as they stand, so loosen with water or broth to your preferred consistency; heat until steaming throughout.

proposal.explanation: Remixed the seed into three distinct six-serving batch meals, using fresh grated ginger in place of ground ginger throughout.

dishes.title: Fresh Ginger Turkey Tomato Pot
steps: Heat olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add turkey and break it up; cook until no longer pink, about 7–9 minutes.
Stir in onions and cook until softened, about 6 minutes. Add garlic and grated ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partly, and cook 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and the turkey is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve as is or sprinkle individual portions with cheddar.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate in shallow containers. Reheat a portion covered in the microwave, stirring halfway, or warm on the stovetop with a splash of water until steaming hot; add cheese after reheating.

dishes.title: Ginger Turkey, Tomato and Bean Chili

ingredients.displayName: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in the pot over medium-high heat. Add turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 7–9 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and grated ginger for 1 minute.
Add chili powder, cumin, crushed tomatoes, beans, water, and salt. Stir well and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and the turkey is cooked through. Adjust seasoning to taste.
dishes.reheatTip: Store in shallow containers in the refrigerator. Reheat covered in the microwave, stirring once, or gently on the stovetop; add a little water if the chili has thickened.

dishes.title: Ginger Turkey Tomato and Cheddar Bake
steps: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook turkey, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 7–9 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and grated ginger for 1 minute, then add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer 8 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to the baking dish, cover with foil, and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover, scatter cheddar over the top, and bake 10–12 minutes more, until bubbling and hot throughout.
dishes.reheatTip: Cool and refrigerate in individual portions. Microwave covered, stirring or rotating midway, until steaming hot; alternatively reheat covered in a 350°F (175°C) oven until hot.

steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and drain and rinse the beans.
Heat oil in a large pot. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then add garlic and turkey. Break up and cook until turkey reaches 165°F.

Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook turkey, breaking it up, until it reaches 165°F. Add zucchini and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Mix in tomatoes, seasoning, salt and pasta. Transfer to a baking dish, top with shredded mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.

dishes.title: Garlic chicken, potatoes and broccoli
dishes.appliance: Oven and two rimmed sheet pans
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes into 1-inch pieces, broccoli into florets, and mince garlic.
Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil and a little salt. Spread on one pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss broccoli with 1 tablespoon oil. Coat chicken with remaining oil, garlic, remaining salt and pepper. Place chicken and broccoli on the second pan.
Roast both pans for 20 minutes more, until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F. Divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate portions within 2 hours. Reheat covered in the microwave until the chicken and vegetables reach 165°F, stirring or rotating as needed.

dishes.title: Smoky sausage, sweet potato and peppers
dishes.appliance: Oven and two rimmed sheet pans
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes, peppers and onion into chunks, and kielbasa into thick slices.
Toss sweet potatoes with half the oil, paprika and salt. Spread on one pan and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss peppers and onion with remaining oil, then spread on the second pan with the kielbasa.
Roast both pans for another 20 minutes, stirring once, until the sweet potatoes are tender and sausage is hot. Divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate portions within 2 hours. Microwave covered, stirring halfway, until heated throughout to 165°F.

dishes.title: Lemon chickpea and zucchini tray bake
dishes.appliance: Oven and two rimmed sheet pans
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Drain and rinse chickpeas. Cut zucchini, tomatoes and onion into bite-size pieces; mince garlic.
Toss chickpeas and vegetables with oil, garlic, oregano and salt. Spread across two sheet pans.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until vegetables are tender and chickpeas are hot.
Squeeze lemon over the trays, crumble feta on top and divide into four portions.
dishes.reheatTip: Refrigerate portions within 2 hours. Microwave covered, stirring halfway, until heated throughout to 165°F.
